{{Quote|There's a title reserved for the most prestigious among us, whose wisdom and skill safeguard the galaxy. It hasn't been bestowed in thousands of years.''"<br />"''But you have proved worthy. Now the Council names you Barsen'thor, Warden of the Order.|Masters Jaric Kaedan and Syo Bakarn, granting the Jedi the distinguished title|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Vivicar's ship}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] proved himself worthy to be granted the title of "'''Barsen'thor'''," a [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]] word meaning "Warden of the Order." The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was only the third person to attain the prestigious rank in the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the first in [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Found as a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] to be gifted with an incredibly deep innate connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the future [[Barsen'thor]] followed the path of a [[Jedi Consular]], [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under Jedi Master [[Yuon Par]] on the [[Je'daii Order|ancestral]] Jedi [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. During his training in [[3643 BBY]], Master Par's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was instrumental in [[Search for the Fount of Rajivari|finding]] the fabled [[Fount of Rajivari]], an ancient repository of knowledge, and he [[Duel at the Forge|stopped]] the corrupted [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Nalen Raloch]] from destroying the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]], a machine used by the ancient Jedi to create [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

The victory over Raloch earned the Consular a promotion from the rank of Padawan, as well as the loyalty of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Qyzen Fess]], who came to regard him as the "'''Scorekeeper's Herald'''"&mdash;champion of the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]], a [[Trandoshan religion|Trandoshan deity]] who governed the Afterlife. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], a sickness known as the [[Dark Plague]] [[Dark Plague crisis|struck]] the Jedi Order, driving Jedi Masters across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] insane. [[Mission to Coruscant (Barsen'thor)|Learning]] an ancient [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]] called the [[shielding technique]] from the [[Noetikon]] devices, the newly promoted Jedi traveled from planet to planet, using the technique to sever the sick Jedi Masters from the influence of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] mastermind behind the plague. Eventually, the Consular [[Duel on Vivicar's ship|confronted]] the plaguemaster himself, who was [[Possession/Legends|possessed]] by the [[Essence transfer|spirit]] of the plague's long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] creator [[Terrak Morrhage]]. He successfully redeemed Vivicar, driving out Morrhage's [[Soul/Legends|spirit]] and restoring Vivicar's former persona of Jedi Padawan Parkanas Tark. The Consular was also recruited into the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] elite [[Coruscant Aegis]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class light corvette]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Guardian'''."

Defeating Vivicar was the accomplishment that earned the Jedi the title of Barsen'thor. With that victory also came another assignment, from the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] himself. Granted the title of Jedi Master, the Barsen'thor was assigned as an [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] to the [[Rift Alliance]], an organization of worlds seeking to secede from the Republic due to disillusionment with the galactic government's ignorance of their planets' problems. After [[Attack on the Fortitude|rescuing]] the representatives of the Rift Alliance from a Sith attack, the Barsen'thor tried to [[Diplomat/Legends|convince]] the [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] to come back into the Republic's fold. In order to do so, however, he had to prove the Republic's worth to the Rift Alliance. To this end, he performed a number of tasks on behalf of the Rift Alliance on the planets [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Quesh]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

Having secured the trust of the Rift Alliance, the Barsen'thor participated in the [[Hunt for the Children|fight]] against the [[Children of the Emperor]], unwitting Imperial agents who had infiltrated deep within the ranks of the Republic, their presence masked by the power of the mysterious [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]]. In the meantime, a second [[Galactic War]] began between the Republic and the Empire. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Consular [[Capture of the Javelin|discovered]] that the First Son was in fact a [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper persona]] implanted inside Jedi Master Syo [[Bakarn family|Bakarn]], who had been guiding the Barsen'thor since the latter's departure from Tython. The Barsen'thor eventually confronted the First Son in the [[Cave/Legends|caves]] below [[Corellia]]'s [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], defeating him and successfully bringing back Bakarn's personality. Doing so removed the First Son's shroud over the other Children, revealing them to the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. With the Empire having been dealt a major blow, the Barsen'thor and his many allies were [[Coruscant award ceremony|celebrated]] as heroes on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

The victorious Jedi Master was rewarded with Bakarn's vacant seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. He also accepted the young Force prodigy [[Nadia Grell]] as his Padawan, following the last will of her late [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]]. Having attained the reputation for being a wise and respected member of the Council, the Barsen'thor joined the [[Revanite crisis|fight]] against the mad Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in [[3637 BBY]] and later led the Jedi Council's search for the means to stop the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. The Barsen'thor disappeared by the year [[3636 BBY]], around the time when Vitiate&mdash;in the guise of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Valkorion]]&mdash;[[Eternal Empire raids|entered]] his secret [[Eternal Empire]] as a third faction in the Galactic War. The Jedi Master was still missing [[3631 BBY|five years later]] when an [[Eternal Alliance|alliance]] of various factions was formed [[War against Zakuul|against]] the Eternal Empire. After his death, the Barsen'thor was laid to rest in an elaborate [[Chandrila Jedi tomb|tomb]] located in the [[Crystal Canyons]] on the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].

==Biography==
===Early Jedi training===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point during the period of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]] marked by<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> the [[Great Galactic War]] of [[3681 BBY|3681]]&ndash;[[3653 BBY]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="GGW dates">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that the [[Great Galactic War]] lasted from [[3681 BBY]] until [[3653 BBY]].</ref> and the following [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> A [[Youngling/Legends|child]] prodigy whose [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] manifested at a very early age,<ref name="Attis Station">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Attis Station|Quesh}}</ref> he<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under a number of [[Jedi instructor]]s during the Cold War. The young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] was considered extremely wise for such a young age and displayed a remarkable connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], something unheard of in [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]].<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

===Training on Tython===
====Arrival====
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|There is no emotion, there is peace. There is no ignorance, there is knowledge. There is no passion, there is serenity. There is no chaos, there is harmony. There is no death, there is the Force.|Master Syo Bakarn recites the Jedi Code to the young Jedi|<ref name="Trials in Kaleth">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Trials in Kaleth|Tython}}</ref>}}
By the year [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} Since the [[Jedi Consular]] Prologue mission "Pilgrims" refers to [[Sumari]] as the [[Kalikori village]]'s reigning [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] and Sumari [[Death/Legends|dies]] in the course of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight Prologue, during the mission "The Face of the Enemy," the beginning of the Jedi Consular storyline must take place at some point by 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the young Jedi was sent to the ancestral Jedi [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to learn from an official mentor, so that he could complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and further develop his unique connection with the Force, following the path of a [[Jedi Consular]]. The Jedi was assigned as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to a respected [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi Researcher|scholar]] called [[Yuon Par]], who specialized in [[Jedi archaeologist|archaeology]]. Arriving via a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down to the planet's surface, the young Jedi landed at a remote [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] [[Jedi temple/Legends|temple]] known as the [[Masters' Retreat]]. There, he was greeted by a famed [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] Member, Master [[Syo Bakarn]], while Master Par was delayed on her archaeological inquiries.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

[[File:YuonPar.png|thumb|left|220px|Yuon Par, the Consular's Master]]
When Par finally arrived, she informed her new apprentice of an urgent matter. A team of Jedi researchers had recently uncovered several teaching [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]&mdash;priceless [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecordings]] made by the founders of the Jedi Order&mdash;in the region known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls]]. However, the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, known for their tendency to destroy such invaluable findings, had started rampaging through the region.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

As a first [[Search for the Fount of Rajivari|official training task]], Par's Padawan was assigned to go to the Gnarls and retrieve the hologram's [[Holoprojector/Legends|projectors]] so that they could be preserved. Armed only with a [[Electroblade training sword/Legends|practice saber]], the Padawan defeated the attacking Flesh Raiders and retrieved three of the four devices, containing the recordings made by Masters [[Cala Brin]], [[Garon Jard]], and [[Ters Sendon]]. However, he found out that the fourth holoprojector had been stolen.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

Using a personal [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] device, he reported the discovery to Master Par, who was surprised by the news. The Flesh Raiders were not known for stealing [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifacts]], as they usually destroyed them outright. Par promised to look into the matter and instructed the student to meet her at the Tython's main [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> Arriving at the Temple, the Padawan was greeted by a fellow young trainee, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Hallen (Jedi)|Hallen]], who instructed him to speak with Master [[Wettle]] in order to receive some training in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] from him. After following Hallen's advice and meeting with Wettle,<ref name="Wisdom of Elders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Wisdom of Elders|Tython}}</ref> the Padawan reported to Par, finding her engaged in a conversation with a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. The Jedi Master introduced the latter as [[Qyzen Fess]], an old friend of hers who was on Tython on a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] expedition.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

====Confronting Raloch====
{{Quote|Jedi condemn what they can't control. But you're not a concern. Only the Flesh Raiders matter. Rajivari's hologram showed me how to punish them. The Flesh Raiders will come. But not leave. A merciful death, compared to what my people have suffered.|Raloch reveals his motives to the Jedi|<ref name="Pilgrims">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Pilgrims|Tython}}</ref>}}
The young apprentice was informed by Par that the missing recording belonged to Master [[Rajivari]], the fourth of the founding members of the Order, who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and betrayed his fellow Masters. Par also shared with the apprentice her suspicions regarding the identity of the thief, believing that a member of the [[Kalikori village]] was responsible. The village was an illegal settlement of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]], driven from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by religious prosecution. As the Pilgrims lived in a state of poverty, Par surmised that the thief was most likely intending to sell the ancient device for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and she urged her apprentice to intervene.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />

[[File:Raloch_force.png|thumb|right|275px|Raloch using the Force to collapse the cave]]
Afraid that the holoprojector could hold the most powerful and darkest secrets of Rajivari, Par tasked the Padawan with traveling to the Kalikori village and speaking with the [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|captain of the village guard]], [[Bashenn]], in hopes of discovering the thief's identity. However, he was instructed to be delicate in that task, as the Jedi Order was officially forbidden from helping the Pilgrims, due to them being on Tython in violation of Republic law.<ref name="Pilgrims" />

Once at the Kalikori village, the Padawan spoke to Bashenn as instructed and discovered that [[Nalen Raloch]], the village's dueling champion and the person responsible for defending his people against Flesh Raider attacks, had taken the holoprojector and ventured deep into Flesh Raider territory. The Padawan followed Raloch's path and found the holoprojector in [[Nalen Raloch's cave camp|Raloch's camp]] established inside a [[Cave/Legends|cave]].<ref name="Pilgrims" />

Raloch soon arrived himself, explaining to the Consular that the reason he had stolen the holoprojector was to find a way to defeat the Flesh Raiders once and for all, thus protecting the people of the Kalikori village from them. Raloch was, in fact, sensitive to the Force and had gained some knowledge on how to manipulate it from Rajivari's hologram. Demonstrating what he had learned, Raloch used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|collapse]] the cave in an attempt to attract the Raiders there and have them killed. After doing so, the Twi'lek left the scene. The Consular took Rajivari's holoprojector and,<ref name="Pilgrims" /> fighting through the Flesh Raiders attracted by the groundquake,<ref name="Survival of the Fittest">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Survival of the Fittest|Tython}}</ref> managed to escape from the cave as well. Bringing the projector to Par, he activated it, hoping to learn what Raloch had been after. However, the holographic image of Rajivari merely spoke enigmatically of some sort of "true wisdom," which he had hidden at a location which the "first blade at the sanctuary of the Order" pointed at.<ref name="Pilgrims" />

====The Fount of Rajivari====
{{Quote|After Rajivari fell, sources claimed he created a great archive of his knowledge and teachings. The Fount of Rajivari. Generations of Jedi searched for it, finding nothing. The Fount's considered a hoax by all reputable scholars, but&hellip;we just heard proof.|Yuon Par, after seeing Rajivari's holorecording|<ref name="Trials in Kaleth" />}}
Master Par realized that the "true wisdom" Rajivari spoke of was the [[Fount of Rajivari]], a rumored collection of the fallen Master's teachings. The Fount was considered a hoax by the Jedi after numerous unsuccessful attempts to locate it, but the holorecording provided definite proof of its existence. Master Par also deduced that "the sanctuary of the Order" referred to [[Kaleth]], an ancient [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] of the [[Je'daii Order]], an organization that had preceded the Jedi Order and which Rajivari had helped reform into the latter. The fortress's name was a Je'daii word meaning "sanctum." To that end, Par sent her Padawan to the ruins of Kaleth to retrieve the mysterious "first blade" in order to locate the Fount before Raloch, who she believed would also be looking for it.<ref name="Pilgrims" />

[[File:Tythonian_War_Droid.png|thumb|left|220px|The Jedi encountered Tythonian War Droids among the ruins of Kaleth.]]
Among the ruins of Kaleth, the Consular found a [[Burial/Legends|grave]] containing the remains of the [[Weapon Master]], an ancient [[Je'daii Master]] and the creator of the [[First Blade]], the weapon that had served as the foundation of all modern [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. The [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of the First Blade had been hidden among the remains of the Weapon Master and had been guarded all those [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] by ancient [[Tythonian War Droid]]s. In order to be allowed access to the hilt, [[Unidentified Tythonian war droid|one]] of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] instructed the Consular to undertake the challenges the Weapon Master had devised for his students to prove their [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat prowess]].<ref name="Trials in Kaleth" />

The Padawan defeated a number of [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]] near Kaleth and was granted access to the hilt, which appeared heavily modified and contained data encrypted in it by Rajivari. As he reported that discovery to Master Par, the latter started to believe that the Force itself had intervened in the training of her Padawan and was now guiding the training process, an opinion which&mdash;as the Padawan later discovered in a meeting with Masters Syo Bakarn and [[Jaric Kaedan]]&mdash;was not shared by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Trials in Kaleth" />

The Padawan delivered the hilt of the First Blade to Par, who informed her apprentice that after further analysis of Rajivari's hologram, she had found out that the hilt needed to be taken into a [[First Jedi Council's meeting cave|cave]] in the nearby [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], which had once served as the meeting place for the very first Jedi Council. Once brought inside the cave, the hilt would then supposedly point to the location of the Fount. Fess, who was once again present during the conversation, stated that he would assist Par and the Padawan in their search and departed from the Jedi Temple to the cave with a head start.<ref name="Trials in Kaleth" />

====Investigating Rajivari's history====
{{Quote|Here, in this cave, we founders discussed our vision for the Jedi Order. And I, Rajivari, listened. I listened, as they carefully crippled our newborn order. As they argued for mediocrity. It shall not stand. I have laid my plans. With my army made from Tython's true dark sons, I will purge this council of fools while they chatter.|The hologram of Rajivari tells the Jedi its story|<ref name="Hunter's Eye">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Hunter's Eye|Tython}}</ref>}}
[[File:Council_cave.png|thumb|right|275px|The Jedi Consular's search took him to the meeting place of the very first Jedi Council.]]
After making way to the cave, the young Jedi fought through a number of Flesh Raiders inside and reached the cave's end, locating a number of ceremonial carvings and a pile of [[Bone/Legends|bones]]. He also met Fess there, who agreed to share "[[Jagannath point/Legends|Jagannath points]]" with the Jedi for their "hunt." The Padawan did not understand what the Trandoshan was talking about, so Fess explained to him that Jagganath points were a concept of the [[Trandoshan religion]] that he adhered to.<ref name="Hunter's Eye" />

A Trandoshan was granted Jagganath points for each kill by the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] known as the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] whom would determine the Trandoshans' placement in the Afterlife based on how many Jagannath they had collected in their lifetime. Removing the pile of bones, the Consular discovered an ancient pedestal, which contained an alcove the same shape as the First Blade. However, a trio of Twi'lek Pilgrims from the Kalikori village, led by a female called [[Allia (Twi'lek)|Allia]], entered the cave. The Pilgrims, who were working for Raloch, demanded that the Consular handed the hilt to them, but he was able to convince them that Raloch had been corrupted by his thirst for power, and the Twi'leks left peacefully.<ref name="Hunter's Eye" />

Inserting the hilt inside the pedestal, the Consular was presented with another recording of Rajivari, discovering that the Jedi Master and the three fellow founders of the Jedi Order had become members of the very first Jedi Council. However, Rajivari had had disagreements with the rest of the Jedi Council regarding which direction the fledgling Order should have been taken. Therefore, he had assembled an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Rajivari's followers|followers]] and had planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] his fellow Councilors in an attempt to rebuild the Order with his own [[Principles of Rajivari|set of principles]]. The image of Rajivari also provided the Consular with a [[Map/Legends|map]] showing the way to the Fount, but the Padawan was unable to decipher the map's directions.<ref name="Hunter's Eye" />

====Learning the Principles====
{{Quote|Master Rajivari's gone. The Council survived&mdash;we failed. They'll come for us. They'll have to lay siege if they want to take us prisoner. We can't give in. Master Rajivari's fifth principle says showing mercy to an enemy creates a spiral of destruction. We'll take plenty of Jedi with us.|A recording made by [[Cahel Tse]], one of Rajivari's apprentices|<ref name="The Footsteps of the Fallen">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Footsteps of the Fallen|Tython}}</ref>}}
The Jedi and Fess returned to Master Par, who showed her apprentice a holographic recording she had received from Raloch. The Twi'lek had been set back in his search for the Fount after his fellow Pilgrims had failed to bring him the hilt, but he claimed to have knowledge of other ways to find Rajivari's archive, and he threatened to kill the Consular should the latter try to stop him. The Padawan, his Master and Fess analyzed a set of three coordinates shown in Rajivari's map. They were able to decipher two of them, but the third one, which looked like a rock formation, was unfamiliar to both Par and the young Jedi. However, Fess stated that during his hunting trips, he had seen similar markings around a [[Waterfall cave|nearby cave]] located behind a [[Water/Legends|waterfall]]. The Trandoshan told the two that he would investigate the area in an attempt to find something that could help their search.<ref name="Hunter's Eye" />

[[File:Search_for_the_Fount.png|thumb|left|250px|Fess, Par, and her student studying the map]]
The map's code, however, also contained a warning that the path to the Fount of Rajivari was filled with numerous traps that only those who had knowledge of Rajivari's philosophies and who followed his steps could pass. Kaleth was known to have served as the fortress of Rajivari and his followers, and several [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals had been found earlier among the ruins. Believing that the terminals could be accessed using the hilt of the First Blade,<ref name="Hunter's Eye" /> the Consular traveled to Kaleth in hopes of finding some records of Rajivari's teachings in those terminals.<ref name="The Footsteps of the Fallen" />

The terminals indeed contained recordings made by Rajivari's apprentices. The Padawan discovered that Rajivari's [[Rajivari's purges|attempts to kill]] the Jedi Council had failed, and the Jedi Order had [[Siege of Kaleth|besieged]] Kaleth in retaliation. Rajivari's followers had held the line to the end, but had ultimately all been killed, while their Master had abandoned them and escaped. The young Jedi learned several of Rajivari's principles, which dictated that mercy was a foolish act and held strength in great esteem. Returning to Par, he discovered that Fess had not returned from his mission yet.<ref name="The Footsteps of the Fallen" />

====Inside the Fount====
{{Quote|Was captured alive, small hunter. Is not greater dishonor. Means all my points forfeit. Lifetime's score, gone. Without score, I am nothing. Scorekeeper turns face away.|Qyzen Fess confesses his shame to the Consular|<ref name="Rajivari's Legacy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Rajivari's Legacy|Tython}}</ref>}}
The Jedi traveled to the waterfall cave in search of the Trandoshan, encountering a band of hostile Twi'leks loyal to Raloch inside. Defeating them, he found Fess and freed him from a cage, learning that he had deciphered the last coordinate. The Trandoshan explained that Raloch had tracked and captured him, questioning him about the location of the Fount. After he had refused to tell anything to Raloch, he had been visited by Master Par, who had asked for the final coordinate and had behaved very strangely. Confused, Fess had nevertheless told Par what he had discovered. However, the Consular realized that since the real Par had been at the Jedi Temple all that [[Time/Legends|time]], the image Fess had seen must have a been a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force trick]] employed by Raloch. With the knowledge of the final coordinate gained from Fess, he was able to triangulate the location of the Fount, which turned out to be an ancient acropolis inside the [[Ruined Tythonian city|ruins of an ancient city]].<ref name="Rajivari's Legacy" />

[[File:Vur_Tepe_Ruins.png|thumb|right|275px|The ruined city near Vur Tepe, visited by the Consular during the search for the Fount]]
Distraught at being captured alive, which was considered the greatest of humiliations in his religion and had resulted in him losing all of his Jagganath points, Fess decided to accompany the Consular in the search for Raloch, hoping to reclaim some of the honor he had lost. After defeating a large number of Flesh Raiders inside the acropolis, the Padawan and Fess faced the traps the map had mentioned.<ref name="Rajivari's Legacy" />

A series of visions manifested before the aspiring Jedi, presenting challenges associated with Rajivari's philosophies. The Jedi and Fess were able to pass all the challenges and finally reached the Fount of Rajivari. To the pair's surprise, they discovered that the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Rajivari himself inhabited the Fount. Rajivari's stubbornness had allowed him to cheat death and to remain as a ghost inside his [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], where he had been waiting for a new apprentice who would bring his vision of the Jedi Order to life.<ref name="Rajivari's Legacy" />

Rajivari informed the Padawan that Raloch had already visited the Fount and had left after learning from him. According to Rajivari, Raloch was greatly changed by the power he had discovered within the Fount, however, and was seeking to destroy the Jedi Order completely, starting with the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]], an ancient machine used to make lightsabers. Rajivari realized the mistake he had made by teaching Raloch, explaining that the destruction of the Order was never his goal&mdash;he merely intended to rebuild it. The spirit of the Jedi Master asked the Consular to stop Raloch. In order to do so, Rajivari advised the Padawan to find a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] inside the caves leading to the Forge and then use that crystal to power the hilt of the First Blade, allowing him to create a fully functional lightsaber at the Forge. Rajivari then became one with the Force, while the Consular and Fess departed toward the Forge.<ref name="Rajivari's Legacy" />

====Defending the Forge====
{{Quote|Before this Council, I take from you the title of Padawan, I name you a full Jedi of our order. Honor the past. Work&hellip;for the future. May the Force be always with you. You've&hellip;done so well, my student. I'm&hellip;|Master Yuon Par knighting her student in the aftermath of the battle with Raloch, before collapsing unconscious|<ref name="The Forge">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Forge|Tython}}</ref>}}
Passing through the caves leading to the ancient machine, the two found a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] formation. However, when the Padawan tried to extract one of the crystals, he was attacked by a [[Dark Beast]] that guarded the caves. Having defeated the beast and gathered a [[Color/Legends|green]] lightsaber crystal, the Padawan and his Trandoshan companion reached the Forge ahead of Raloch. While Fess stood guard, the Consular deeply concentrated and used the machine to create a working lightsaber. He barely had time to test the weapon before Raloch appeared, escorted by Allia and another Twi'lek named [[Keth (Twi'lek)|Keth]].<ref name="The Forge" />

[[File:Nalen_pointing.png|thumb|left|275px|Raloch and his entourage challenging the Jedi to a fight]]
Raloch's companions hesitated to follow their leader's plan of destroying the Forge, although Raloch tried to convince them that what he was doing was right. Ultimately, Allia and Keth decided to stay out of the fight as Raloch [[Duel at the Forge|attacked]] the Consular. The Jedi defeated the fallen Twi'lek but spared his life, instead instructing him to go to the Jedi Temple, where his fate would be decided. After Allia and Keth took the wounded Raloch away, Fess approached the Consular. The Trandoshan was impressed by his bravery and proclaimed that he would follow the Jedi everywhere he would go, as Fess now considered him to be the "Herald of the Scorekeeper."<ref name="The Forge" />

The Padawan and Fess returned to the Jedi Temple to report on the mission's progress to the Jedi Council and Master Par. There, the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order, [[Satele Shan]], informed the two that Raloch had been undergoing [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] treatment after their battle. Believing the Consular ready to become a fully fledged Jedi, Master Shan asked him to decide Raloch's fate as a final test. Believing in the possibility of the man's redemption, the Padawan instructed Raloch to be trained as a Jedi so that he could learn to control his burgeoning Force abilities.<ref name="The Forge" />

Following that decision, Par proclaimed her apprentice a full Jedi. However, in the midst of the [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]], she suddenly [[Dark Plague crisis|fell ill]]. When Par was taken for treatment, Fess revealed that the woman had been suffering from her illness for a long time, but she had chosen to keep it a secret from everyone but the Trandoshan. It was decided to send Master Par to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in hopes that Jedi researchers&mdash;who were working on excavating the old [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] that had been ravaged during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]&mdash;might find something to cure her. In the meantime, the Jedi on Tython would study the discoveries the Consular had made pertaining to the Fount of Rajivari. The newly appointed Jedi was then instructed to travel to Coruscant as well in order to oversee Par's treatment.<ref name="The Forge" />

===The threat of the Dark Plague===
====Arrival on Coruscant====
Embarking on the journey, the Consular and Fess first took a shuttle that brought them to [[Carrick Station]], the main staging area of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]].<ref name="An Afflicted Master">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|An Afflicted Master|Tython}}</ref> There, the pair were greeted by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Jedi Master [[Ostar-Gal]], [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Keeper]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and a close friend of Par's. Ostar-Gal advised the Jedi to seek out Master [[Dynaroth]] for the next phase of his training. Master Dynaroth, in turn, helped him choose the path to follow, either that of a [[Jedi Sage]] or a [[Jedi Shadow]].<ref name="Advanced Training: Jedi Consular">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Advanced Training: Jedi Consular|Republic Fleet}}</ref>

[[File:Attros_Finn.png|thumb|right|220px|The Consular closely worked with Attros Finn on Coruscant while looking for a cure for Yuon Par's condition.]]
Arriving on Coruscant, the Consular and Fess [[Mission to Coruscant (Barsen'thor)|traveled]] to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and met with [[Attros Finn]], a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi researcher who was tending to Par. The Jedi found Par in an unstable condition, seemingly talking nonsense about someone named [[Parkanas Tark|Parkanas]] as well as a mysterious "Dark Man." Finn believed that the key to discovering the cure to Par's illness could be found within the Jedi Archives, but accessing the information was a problem, since the Temple currently laid in ruins. However, the Temple's artificers had created a set of three special [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], called the [[Noetikon]]s, to sort through all the information contained within the Archives, with the personalities of the Order's greatest Masters imprinted in those holocrons.<ref name="The Arrival">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Arrival|Coruscant}}</ref>

The Noetikons had been stolen from the Temple after it was ransacked by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but Finn had a lead on one of the devices. [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant security]] had witnessed [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] from the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a shady [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] consortium, carrying a Noetikon. [[Unidentified Gand scavenger|One of the Gand]] had been detained, but he refused to talk. The Consular and Fess then departed to the [[Old Galactic Market]] to speak with Republic [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] [[Alec Efran]], who had the Gand in custody, while Finn began working on finding a lead to the second artifact.<ref name="The Arrival" />

====Into the Black Sun's den====
{{Quote|Those smugglers are dying, Jedi. I need that contraband out of them, but I have my hands full here. Can you help?|Doctor Maer asks the Jedi for assistance|<ref name="The Flow of Goods">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Flow of Goods|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
The Jedi confronted the Gand scavenger, persuading him to talk about the location of the Noetikon. The Gand revealed that a man named [[Lars Baddeg]] had delivered it to the leader of the Gand scavengers, [[Aulus G'luun]], and had instructed him to keep the relic out of Jedi hands. To that end, G'luun had developed a system of special signals, which he issued from a signal station in the Old Galactic Market on occasion, passing the Noetikon from one Gand to another for safekeeping. The Consular and Fess managed to crack the Gands' code and summoned G'luun himself to a meeting place, convincing him to hand over the Noetikon, which turned out to be the [[Noetikon of Science]]. Its [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeepers]], Masters [[Tharis Orne]], [[Arca Jeth]] and [[Vandar Tokare]], scoured their vast library of [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] knowledge but were unable to find any clues regarding Par's sickness.<ref name="Secret Signals">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Secret Signals|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:Noetikon_of_Science_Hologram.png|thumb|left|275px|The Consular consulting the Noetikon of Science]]
Ruling out any [[Medic/Legends|medical]] sickness as a possible answer, they instead suggested that the Jedi seek out the [[Noetikon of Light]] and consult its gatekeepers on any mystical illness that could fit the description. The Consular and Fess returned to Finn, who had found a lead on the second Noetikon. His assistant, [[Pharen]], had a [[Pharen's sister|sister]] who was working at the [[Silent Sun cantina]] in an [[Black Sun territory|area of Coruscant]] controlled by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. Pharen's sister had seen the Noetikon among one of the shipments going inside the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], which the Black Sun used as a secret warehouse.<ref name="Secret Signals" /> The Jedi and Fess traveled through the dangerous Black Sun territory and reached the Silent Sun cantina.<ref name="The Flow of Goods" />

The Consular found a number of sick Black Sun [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] inside, who experienced pain from contraband Jedi artifacts implanted inside of them, and who were being treated by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] called [[Maer (doctor)|Maer]]. Using a special [[Magnetic ID scanner|scanner]], the Jedi traced the [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] ID tag of the Noetikon of Light and identified the [[Unidentified Black Sun smuggler|man]] carrying the artifact inside of him. He helped the man by undoing the surgery using Maer's medical equipment and extracted the Noetikon from his body. The Jedi then activated the Noetikon, consulting Masters [[Noab Hulis]], [[Wole Vahn]], and [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi Da'Boda]], but they had no information on the cure either. As a final desperate measure, the gatekeepers directed him and the Trandoshan to the last Noetikon, the [[Noetikon of Secrets]].<ref name="The Flow of Goods" />

====Trapped====
{{Quote|Next question: What does the wise person know?|Master of Questions|<ref name="Shadows">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shadows|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
The Jedi was then contacted by Finn, who informed him that Par's condition had deteriorated and she had even attacked Pharen. Finn had her restrained, but he asked the Consular and Fess to return to the Senate Building and hopefully calm her down. The duo found the ill Jedi Master agitated, willing to hurt someone. Lacking self-control, Par activated her lightsaber and attacked her former student. The latter was able to defeat the Jedi Master, knocking her unconscious.<ref name="The Coming Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Coming Darkness|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:Fake_Noetikon_of_Secrets.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi and Fess were briefly held captive by the consciousness inside the fake Noetikon of Secrets.]]
Realizing that Par's condition worsened with every [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]], the Consular and Fess embarked on the search for the final Noetikon.<ref name="Shadows" /> The two had learned from one of Maer's patients, [[Curt Willham]], that Lars Baddeg was a member of the [[Justicars' Brigade]], a local Coruscant vigilante organization that was involved in smuggling Jedi artifacts offworld.<ref name="The Flow of Goods" /> Following that lead, they traveled to the [[Justicar territory]] and located Baddeg, who revealed that he was working for someone else; the contractor had promised Baddeg more power in exchange for the Noetikons. Seemingly giving up on his cause when confronted, Baddeg told the Consular to simply take the final Noetikon.<ref name="Shadows" />

However, the Noetikon turned out to be a [[Fake Noetikon of Secrets|fake]]; once it was activated, the Jedi and his Trandoshan companion appeared in a room filled with white light and were confronted by an entity calling herself the [[Master of Questions]]. The Master of Questions agreed to let the Jedi go, provided he answered three questions correctly. However, an incorrect answer would lead to the Jedi being trapped inside forever.<ref name="Shadows" />

The Consular answered the questions correctly and was able to escape from Baddeg's trap, witnessing him talking to a a [[Unidentified Sith apprentice (Lord Vivicar)|Sith]], who revealed that he was merely a servant of another Master. However, once the Sith saw the Consular and Fess unscathed, he instructed Baddeg to kill them. The Justicar tried to follow the command, but the pair defeated him and retrieved the real Noetikon of Secrets.<ref name="Shadows" />

====Learning the ritual====
{{Quote|A Jedi healer, whose sacrifice, unlike his name, has not been forgotten, developed a shielding technique to release Morrhage's hold on his victims.|Jedi Master Chamma|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
The Noetikon's gatekeepers were named [[Jesper Altax]], [[Bastila Shan]] and [[Chamma]], who possessed information about the sickness. They informed the Consular about a past [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Terrak Morrhage]], who had created an illness called the [[Dark Plague]] that afflicted the [[Brain/Legends|minds]] of Jedi. Morrhage used the plague to control the minds of his victims, turning them to the dark side by the hundreds and using the afflicted Jedi to [[Terrak Morrhage conflict|fight]] the Order. Morrhage was only stopped when a [[Unidentified Jedi healer|Jedi healer]] developed a [[shielding technique]], which he used to sever the affected Jedi from Morrhage, one by one. The repeated usage of the technique drained the [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer's]] powers and ultimately killed him. The Consular realized that the only way to save Master Par was to learn the technique by combining all three Noetikons at the Jedi Archives inside the ravaged Jedi Temple.<ref name="Shadows" />

[[File:Consular_Performing_Force_Shield.png|thumb|left|275px|The Jedi Consular performing the shielding technique on Yuon Par]]
The Consular and Fess went through [[The Works/Legends|the Works]], the industrial sector of Coruscant, and reached the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Ancient Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Ancient Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> Fighting their way through Imperial forces that had been searching the Temple for a valuable Republic [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]],<ref name="Enemies of the Republic">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Enemies of the Republic|Coruscant}}</ref> the duo reached the Jedi Archives. Once the Consular activated the three Noetikons using a [[Noetikon terminal|special terminal]], all nine holographic Jedi Masters appeared before him. After deep meditation, the Consular, guided by the Masters, learned the shielding technique. Immediately afterward, he was confronted by the same Sith that Baddeg had spoken to.<ref name="Ancient Secrets" />

Upon entering the Archives, the Sith used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to destroy the terminal, effectively preventing future Jedi from ever learning the ritual. The Jedi and Fess were then attacked by the Sith, who was accompanied by two [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]], but the pair managed to defeat the attacker. The two were then contacted by Master Syo Bakarn, who had been overseeing the Consular's progress and who instructed him to hurry back to Master Par, as she was fading away with every minute. Returning to the Senate Building with Fess, the Jedi used the technique to shield Par from the plaguemaster's influence. Although she regained consciousness and felt considerably better, she was still not fully cured until the enigmatic plaguemaster was defeated.<ref name="Ancient Secrets" />

====Curing the afflicted masters====
{{Quote|We've started to receive disturbing communications from other Masters. We fear Yuon's illness is not an isolated case.|Jaric Kaedan|<ref name="Help the Republic Fleet" />}}
[[File:Barsenthor_Defender.png|thumb|right|250px|The Consular's Defender-class light corvette]]
The Jedi Council, gathered on Coruscant, summoned the Consular and Fess and informed them that Master Par's was not an isolated case, as other Masters had begun falling out of contact, supposedly falling victim to the plague. In order to stop the disease from spreading, the Sith controlling it had to be defeated, but the Jedi Order had no clue to the plaguemaster's identity. As such, the young Jedi was asked by the Council to travel around the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], to use the newly acquired technique on the Masters and to try gathering any further clues from them. In order to do so, he was provided with a [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|personal starship]], a [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]], as well as a personal onboard droid, [[C2-N2 (Barsen'thor)|C2-N2]], a non-combat [[Hollis-series steward droid|C2-N2]] unit that served as a medic and ship's steward. After saying goodbye to Par, the Consular and Fess departed Coruscant on the newly acquired [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Ancient Secrets" />

The Consular was also contacted by [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]] [[Judin]] of the Republic Navy, who recruited him into the elite [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] known as the [[Coruscant Aegis]]. The Coruscant Aegis was a brand new initiative created by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Numinn]] that was intended to quickly deal with Imperial offensives around the galaxy. The Consular was given the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Guardian," and he would fly a number of missions for the Coruscant Aegis over the course of the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Help the Republic Fleet" />

=====Into the wilds=====
{{Main|Mission to Taris (Barsen'thor)}}
{{Quote|Master Tykan is an expert in this wilderness. We had received regular reports from him, but&hellip;he has fallen silent.|Syo Bakarn|<ref name="The Expedition">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Expedition|Taris}}</ref>}}
The Jedi's first assignment was to [[Mission to Taris (Barsen'thor)|travel]] to the desolate world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to locate the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] Master [[Cin Tykan]]. A renowned [[Scout/Legends|scout]], survival expert, and pathfinder, Tykan had been assisting the Republic efforts in the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|restoration]] of the desolate planet, but he had recently gone silent and had stopped sending reports to the Jedi Council, leading them to believe that Tykan could have been affected by the plague. After landing on Taris, the Jedi and Fess went to the Republic reclamation base at the city of [[Olaris]] and met Tykan's Padawan [[Aris Vauranelle]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nelex]] of the [[Republic Expeditionary Forces]] at the [[Taris Republic Expeditionary Forces headquarters|Expeditionary Forces' headquarters]].<ref name="The Expedition" />

[[File:Cin_Tykan.png|thumb|right|220px|The Jedi traveled to Taris in search of the missing Master Cin Tykan.]]
Both of them were surprised to hear of Tykan's possible illness, explaining that the Jedi Master had recently left with a research expedition on a mission to take pollution readings and had displayed no signs of the plague. The group made contact with the expedition's Republic guardsman, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Valoy]], learning from him that the expedition had come under attack. Unable to assemble a rescue team in time, Nelex directed the Consular to the expedition's last known coordinates.<ref name="The Expedition" />

Arriving at the marked location in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]], the Jedi and Fess were attacked by a group of assassins from the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization. After defeating them, the Jedi spoke to [[T8-C3]], the expedition's lone [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] that was in the area, which informed them that the expedition had gone offtrack and had been [[Attack on Cin Tykan's expedition|attacked]] by the Death's Claw. Most of the expedition had been killed with the exception of Tykan himself and a small survey team, who had left before the attack, carrying with them the expedition's findings, consisting of several medical holocrons and valuable relics.<ref name="The Expedition" />

=====Repairing the sabotage=====
{{Quote|The holocrons are gone! You fool, what have you done?''"<br />"''Saved my life, doctor. You'd have let me die! And on top of Tykan trying to kill us.|Doctor Edaine and Laria Taphoni comment on the Jedi's choice|<ref name="The Expedition" />}}
Arriving at the survey team's location in the [[Sinking City]] region&mdash;provided by T8-C3&mdash;the Consular and Fess found the place in ruin, with two expedition members&mdash;[[Defte]] and [[Frej]]&mdash;trapped under a large piece of debris. The Jedi used the Force to lift the object and freed the men, only to discover two more members, [[Laria Taphoni]] and [[Tal (Taris)|Tal]], clinging to their lives among the debris engulfed in [[Fire/Legends|fire]]. He used the Force to levitate Tal back to safety and then proceeded to perform the same trick with Taphoni. By choosing to save the woman, however, the Jedi had to sacrifice the holocrons that had also been caught on fire, much to the dismay of the final surviving member of the expedition, Doctor [[Gatten Edaine]], who had insisted on saving the relics instead of Taphoni.<ref name="The Expedition" />

[[File:Edaine_team.png|thumb|left|250px|The Consular rescued the members of Tykan's expedition from certain death.]]
Edaine, Taphoni and Tal explained to the Consular and Fess that after they had found the holocrons during their expedition, Tykan had decided to take them to the base as fast as possible, leaving the rest of the expedition behind at the ambush site. However, he had instead lured the survey team into a trap, having ignited the pollution and leaving them to die, stating that he had been punishing them for letting Taris be [[Destruction of Taris|ravaged]] [[3956 BBY|three hundred years ago]]. The Consular also learned that Tykan's next target was the [[Junction (purification facility)|Junction]], an old purification facility retrofitted by the Republic to process [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gases.<ref name="The Expedition" />

Traveling to the Junction, the duo met the [[Factory/Legends|factory's]] [[Unidentified Junction security chief|security chief]] and the plague-affected Tykan. Like Par, the Kaleesh Master also spoke of a man named Parkanas, as well as a "dark place" called [[Malachor III|Malachor]]. He then proceeded to sabotage the main gas line and opened the factory's vents, letting swarms of [[rakghoul]] [[mutant]]s inside. The event forced the Consular to choose to either repair the Junction&mdash;which was crucial in cleansing the planet&mdash;or to save the factory's workers from the rakghoul attack. The Jedi chose the latter, and he successfully evacuated a maintenance crew that had been trapped behind a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] by using the Force to tear the door open.<ref name="The Junction">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Junction|Taris}}</ref>

=====Tykan's madness=====
{{Quote|Too late, Jedi. You wandered too long, too long. But now the reactor will bathe Taris in fire. No black rock. No shadow. The Republic will not spread it! I can cleanse it here, cauterize the flow!|Master Cin Tykan, while afflicted by the plague|<ref name="Super Reactor">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Super Reactor|Taris}}</ref>}}
After the rest of the staff were evacuated from the areas filled with gas, the [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] thanked the Jedi and Fess and gave them some old Taris infrastructure charts that Tykan had been studying before he fell victim to the plague. The data was encrypted, so the chief instructed the Jedi to bring it to Captain Nelex back at the base in Olaris, where it could be deciphered.<ref name="The Junction" /> The Consular was contacted by Nelex himself, who claimed that the Republic base was under attack. Once they reached the base, the Jedi and Fess found it swarming with rakghouls, which had been released by Tykan from rakghoul tunnels beneath the base.<ref name="Rakghoul Invasion">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Rakghoul Invasion|Taris}}</ref>

[[File:Tykan_saber.png|thumb|right|250px|Master Cin Tykan, afflicted by Lord Vivicar's plague, tried to undermine the Republic's reclamation efforts on Taris.]]
The Jedi and the Trandoshan first attempted to save the base by sealing the tunnels. The Jedi used the Force to collapse rocks in order to seal two secondary tunnels and then defeated a large rakghoul dubbed the "[[Ripclaw (rakghoul)|Ripclaw]]," before picking up a [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|binary loadlifter]] with the Force and using it to collapse the cavern behind the main tunnel. With the base secure, Nelex was then able to decrypt the data provided by the Junction security chief. From those files, they discovered that Tykan had copied all files pertaining to one of Taris's still functional [[Reactor/Legends|super-reactors]]. Sabotaging the reactor could potentially send it into meltdown and trigger a chemical detonation that could destroy the entire Republic reclamation area.<ref name="Rakghoul Invasion" />

The Jedi and Fess went to the reactor's coordinates beneath [[Transport Station 5]] and confronted Tykan and Vauranelle, who had been abducted by her Master. In his delirium, Tykan spoke of a Lord Vivicar, finally revealing the plaguemaster's name. Vauranelle, due to her affection and loyalty for her Master, had come to believe his mad ramblings about the necessity of sabotaging the Republic's reclamation efforts in order to stop their attempts to "destroy the natural beauty" of Taris, but the Consular convinced her to change her mind. The Jedi and Fess were then attacked by the angered Tykan but were able to defeat the Jedi Master. The Consular then used the shielding technique on him, freeing him from Vivicar's influence. Tykan was horrified by the atrocities he had committed and left for Tython to report to the Jedi Council and then to willingly turn himself in to the Republic authorities. The Jedi contacted Bakarn, informing him of the "Lord Vivicar" Tykan had mentioned, and the Jedi Master promised to start looking into that name. The Consular and Fess then left Taris, on the journey to save one more Jedi Master.<ref name="Super Reactor" />

=====The Guiding Hand=====
{{Main|Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Barsen'thor)}}
{{Quote|So, Duras Fain has a vendetta against the Hutt Cartel? If any Jedi Master would risk it, Fain's the one.|Tharan Cedrax|<ref name="The Professor">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Professor|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The Jedi's next [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Barsen'thor)|stop]] was [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a lawless [[Moon/Legends|moon]] ruled by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], which had recently found itself clashing with an emerging criminal organization called the [[Guiding Hand]]. The Guiding Hand's members were fanatically loyal to their leader, who the Jedi Council suspected to be Master [[Duras Fain]], another one of the affected Masters, one who possessed great skill of influencing others with the Force. Fain was known to hate illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade, so the Guiding Hand's repeated attacks on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts']] spice shipments, using tactics that the Jedi Master was known for, provided almost definite proof of Fain's involvement with the gang.<ref name="The Professor" />

[[File:Holiday_and_Tharan.png|thumb|left|250px|Cedrax and his assistant, Holiday]]
The Jedi Council placed utmost priority on stopping Fain, afraid that the Cartel might discover that a Jedi was involved in the attacks on their property, which would cause them to stop providing assistance to the Republic. Bakarn instructed the Consular to visit his contact on Nar Shaddaa, an [[Exo-technology|exo-technologist]] and friend of both Bakarn and Fain named [[Tharan Cedrax]]. When the Consular and Fess arrived at [[Tharan Cedrax's office|Cedrax's office]] at the [[Promenade]], however, the Jedi found that the man was not there. Instead, the pair were greeted by [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]], Cedrax's female holographic assistant. Holiday informed the two that Cedrax had ventured into the [[Nikto Sector]] to deliver a [[Tharan Cedrax's weapon prototype|weapon prototype]] he had been contracted to develop to [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] gangsters.<ref name="The Professor" />

Following Holiday's directions to the meeting place at [[Sawtooth Salvage]], the Jedi and Fess found Cedrax arguing with several Nikto gang members. Having discovered that the Nikto were planning to use the weapon against the Hutt Cartel, Cedrax tried to call the deal off, afraid of the Hutts' vengeance should they discover who had invented the weapon. The Nikto were displeased with that decision and attacked the Jedi and the Trandoshan. After defeating them, the Jedi spoke to Cedrax, telling him about the Council's suspicions of Fain's involvement with the Guiding Hand. Cedrax and the Consular decided that their best course of action was attempting to infiltrate the Guiding Hand.<ref name="The Professor" />

=====Undercover=====
{{Quote|Where's Tharan Cedrax? The darkness is coming. The Lancers need the man who solved the M'raki Uplink Paradox, not some unplugged Jedi.'' [&hellip;] ''Forget this. I have to get Tharan Cedrax for the job. Master's orders.''|Klage|<ref name="Running with the Lancers" />}}
Cedrax then informed the Consular and Fess of the [[Red Light Lancers]], an organization of tech specialists, who were rumored to be a part of the Guiding Hand. The Lancers had been trying to contract Cedrax to do a special job, so he decided to feign interest in it in order to set up a meeting for the Consular. He also provided the Jedi with the weapon prototype in order to prove his expertise to the Lancers, as well as an earpiece so that they could communicate privately.<ref name="The Professor" />

[[File:Klage.png|thumb|right|200px|The Consular was able to gain the trust of the Red Light Lancers' leader, Klage.]]
The Lancers were delighted when Cedrax agreed to meet them, so the Consular and Fess soon went to the [[Red Light Lancers' safehouse|Lancers' safehouse]] in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] to meet with their Zabrak leader, [[Klage]], telling him that Cedrax could not come and had sent them instead. The Zabrak gang leader was reluctant to hire the Consular for the job, since his orders were to get Cedrax specifically. However, after the Jedi gave him the weapon prototype and answered Klage's tech-related questions&mdash;using advice given by Cedrax through the earpiece&mdash;he was deemed skilled enough and was accepted into the Red Light Lancers.<ref name="Running with the Lancers" />

Klage informed the Consular that the job he was hired for was to destroy spice factories shared by the Hutts and the Empire in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]]. The Jedi and Fess were instructed to go to the defense network control room there and disrupt the protocols on the primary control node, triggering the factories' automated defenses and killing everybody inside.<ref name="Running with the Lancers" />

Returning to Cedrax's office, the pair were informed by the scientist that there was a way to do the Lancers' job using a Sith overseer's ID that Cedrax had recently obtained. Unwilling to kill innocent factory workers, however, the Consular demanded Cedrax to come up with an alternative approach. The exo-technologist decided to use a [[resonator key]], a device that, when attached to the primary control node, would fake the network failure. Klage, who would be monitoring the network remotely, would then assume that automated defenses would have been activated as planned.<ref name="Running with the Lancers" />

=====Shadow Town=====
{{Quote|My, my. You've got Tharan Cedrax to care about something, Jedi. That's a gift I want on my side. Now. Serve me and&mdash;agghh! What the&mdash;? What is that thing?|Duras Fain, trying to take control of the Consular and Tharan Cedrax, before being stopped by Cedrax's exo-tech device|<ref name="Shadow Town">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shadow Town|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
Using the Sith overseer's ID, the Consular and Fess were able to fool the factory security at the Lower Industrial Sector and reached the primary control node at the [[Defense Network Control Center]]. Attaching the resonator key was enough to fake the destruction of the factories to Klage, and the duo were contacted by the Lancers' leader. The two were informed by Klage that the Guiding Hand's Master was willing to meet with the new recruit inside the [[Red Light Lancer Headquarters|tech gang's quarters]] in the Red Light Sector.<ref name="Authorized for Sabotage">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Authorized for Sabotage|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Arriving at the provided destination, the Consular and Fess confirmed that the Guiding Hand was indeed led by Fain, who appeared via a hologram and ordered several Nikto [[Morgukai]] cultists present at the scene to kill the two. After the Morgukai were defeated, the Jedi was contacted by Cedrax, who directed the Consular to examine the [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holotransmitter]] Fain had used to contact them.<ref name="The Master">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Master|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

[[File:Fain_saber.png|thumb|left|250px|Duras Fain, the Master behind the Guiding Hand]]
Using [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] subroutines programmed into her by Cedrax, Holiday was able to trace Fain's signal to [[Shadow Town]], an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility located on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="The Master" /> When the Consular and Fess returned to Cedrax's office to develop a plan to infiltrate Shadow Town, the two found a [[Unidentified Hutt Cartel enforcer|Hutt Cartel enforcer]] confronting Cedrax. Rumors of a Jedi's involvement with the Guiding Hand had reached the Hutt Cartel, and as Cedrax had been spotted working with the Consular, the Cartel suspected that the latter could be the Jedi they were looking for. The Jedi was able to persuade the enforcer otherwise and resolved the conflict peacefully.<ref name="Shadow Town" />

After the thug left, the Consular and Cedrax discussed their next move. The scientist presented the Jedi with an [[Tharan Cedrax's anti-mind control device|exo-tech device]] that he had developed in conjunction with Bakarn. The device was designed to block Fain's mind control powers by paralyzing the part of the forebrain that became active when a Jedi tried to exert influence upon a target. The Jedi and Cedrax departed for Shadow Town, fighting through [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial soldiers]] stationed there. Infiltrating an [[Imperial guard tower]], Cedrax used his expertise to disable [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]] throughout the sector, while the Jedi distracted the guards. The duo then infiltrated [[Security Checkpoint 14]], where Cedrax cut the power to [[Duras Fain's hideout|Fain's hideout]]. The two were spotted by an Imperial guard, but the Jedi once again was able to resolve the matter in a non-violent way.<ref name="Shadow Town" />

When they finally confronted Fain after battling a number of his gang members, the Jedi Master told the Consular about an [[Malachor III Expedition|expedition]] to Malachor Three that he and the other affected Jedi had participated in in their youth. Fain claimed that all of the Jedi involved had been affected by the dark side aura of the planet. During that mission, one of their fellow Jedi, a man named Parkanas Tark had been left behind, as the other Jedi evacuated from the planet. Fain then tried to exercise his mind control powers on the Consular and Cedrax, but that failed courtesy of Cedrax's device. The plague-affected Fain attacked the two, but the Jedi and his scientist companion defeated Fain and his guards. Before he could shield Fain, however, a Hutt Cartel enforcer, [[Vorlo Stragen]], arrived, demanding to have Fain handed to the Hutts. The Jedi was able to negotiate with the Cartel to let the Jedi have Fain and then used the shielding technique, freeing Fain from Vivicar's influence. After Fain promised to return to Tython, the Consular and Cedrax parted ways.<ref name="Shadow Town" />

=====Answering a distress call=====
{{Quote|Laranna, my child, my appr&mdash;Jedi. So, you have robbed me of a most promising student. As if that will delay the inevitable. You Jedi are an endless source of amusement.|Expecting to speak with Laranna, Vivicar meets the Consular for the first time|<ref name="Distress Call">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Distress Call|the ''Carida''}}</ref>}}
However, as the Jedi and Fess were returning to their ship to report to Master Bakarn, the two found Cedrax and his holographic assistant waiting for the Jedi in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Finding all of his current contracts boring and spurred by the encounter with Fain, Cedrax wanted to travel the galaxy and seek adventure, so he decided to join the Consular's crew. Having welcomed Cedrax aboard, the Consular contacted Bakarn, who congratulated him on the expert handling of the conflict between the Hutt Cartel and the Guiding Hand. The Consular was also informed of a distress signal from the Republic [[Ajuur-class heavy cruiser|''Ajuur''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Carida (starship)|''Carida'']], supposedly related to the plague. The ship was carrying a Jedi Knight named [[Laranna Fain]], Duras Fain's daughter, aboard. Reports by the Republic forces aboard the ''Carida'' stated that the young Fain had gone insane and had killed several people.<ref name="Shadow Town" />

[[File:Laranna_shielded.png|thumb|right|250px|The Consular shielding Laranna from the Dark Plague]]
Flying to and docking with the ''Carida'', the Consular and one of his companions met with the few remaining [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic soldiers]] led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bela Whinn]]. She explained that the ship had been caught in an [[Attack on the Carida|Imperial ambush]]. Laranna Fain had fought off the attackers, but had been wounded in the process. When the Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had put up a call for medical assistance, a mysterious man had arrived to the ''Carida'', claiming to be a Jedi Master. He had healed Fain and had left, but the girl had changed after their encounter. She had become violent, killing several people and reprogramming the droids aboard the ''Carida'' to attack everyone else in sight. Whinn and the remaining soldiers had managed to lock her down in the ship's aft section, but Fain had started slicing into the ship's computer system, planning to shut down [[Life support/Legends|life support]] and kill everyone aboard.<ref name="Distress Call" />

The Consular and his companion fought through Fain's droids and confronted the young woman, who revealed that the man who had healed her was indeed Lord Vivicar, just as the Consular had suspected. The pair had to [[Mission to the Carida|fight]] Fain, but defeating her was not enough. The girl Force-pushed the Jedi away and locked herself inside an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], threatening to open the outer door and commit suicide. However, the Consular was able to convince Fain to leave the airlock and used the shielding technique on her. Fain, no longer influenced by the plague but still not trusting herself, locked herself down in the brig.<ref name="Distress Call" />

Meanwhile, a holographic message came to the ''Carida'' from Lord Vivicar himself. The Sith tried to contact Fain, but seeing the Consular, he realized that his plan had failed. From the conversation with Vivicar, the Jedi learned that the Sith was once a member of the Jedi Order himself, before embracing the teachings of Morrhage, and that&mdash;as the Jedi Council already suspected&mdash;his control of the plague was limited. Vivicar could only control those he had had personal contact with throughout his lifetime. Leaving Whinn to take control of the ''Carida'' and to bring Fain to Coruscant, the Jedi and his companion returned to their own ship and reported to Master Bakarn, who had news of two more Jedi Masters who had gone silent.<ref name="Distress Call" />

=====Helping the Jawas=====
{{Main|Mission to Tatooine (Barsen'thor)}}
{{Quote|Why you come here? Make trouble? Other Jedi only come to make trouble for Jawas. Go away!|Tteek Tleek|<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Looking Out for the Little Guy|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The Jedi's [[Mission to Tatooine (Barsen'thor)|next assignment]] took him and his companions to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet of Tatooine, where Master [[Eriz Vossan]], one of the Order's best cultural explorers, had dropped out of contact with the Council. The Consular was told by Bakarn to contact [[Rowan Delk]], the man who had served as Master Vossan's guide through the desert and who was now recovering from the [[Sand Rot]], an illness caused by prolonged desert exposure, at the [[Dreviad Outpost]]. Master Vossan's research on the various cultures of the galaxy was considered vital to the Order, so the Consular and one of his companions embarked on the search for the Jedi Master immediately. Conversing with Delk inside the [[Dreviad Medcenter]], the pair were assured by the man that Vossan had not displayed any signs of the plague and was last seen talking to the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in one of their camps in the desert, impressed by their ability to survive in the harsh environment of the planet.<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy" />

[[File:Utttailri_Jawa_Camp.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jawa camp in the aftermath of the attack]]
Upon arriving at the [[Ut'ttailri Jawa Camp]], the Jedi and his companion were attacked by [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]]. After destroying them, the two spoke with one of the Jawas, [[Tteek Tlek]]. The diminutive creature said that Master Vossan&mdash;whom the Jawas had dubbed the "Warmaker"&mdash;had instructed the Jawas to dismantle their camp's [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] and use its parts to build the war droids to conquer the settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and to fight the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]&mdash;a nomadic Tatooine species&mdash;in order to take control of the desert. However, Vossan had then abandoned the Jawas, leaving only a message that they could not decipher and that was intended for Delk.<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy" />

The Consular agreed to help Tlek fix the sandcrawler by retrieving spare parts from local [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] raiders and was given the coded message in gratitude. The Consular and the Jedi's companion returned to Delk's clinic, and the man was able to crack the holorecording's code. Master Vossan stated that he had been looking to find out the answer as to how the species of Tatooine were able to survive in such a hostile environment, in hopes of finding a way to live through the "great darkness." He also spoke of a [[Eriz Vossan's meditation cave|cave]] where he loved to meditate and where he had come up with an idea to seek answers from the "original species" of Tatooine, although he did not mention which species that was. Delk provided the Consular with the location of the cave Vossan had spoken about and some signal [[Flare/Legends|flares]] to light the way.<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy" />

=====Vossan's warriors=====
{{Quote|We were all weak. We all came under the thrall of the dark side. We did things we regretted. But Parkanas was our strength. As we tried to escape, I fell behind, and he ran back to save me. He became trapped&mdash;we had to leave him. It was my weakness that killed him.|Eriz Vossan remembers the ill-fated mission to Malachor Three|<ref name="The Ultimate Warriors">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Ultimate Warriors|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Inside the cave in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]], the Consular lit several torches surrounding a [[Sand People Carving|Sand People carving]]. In the light of the torches, the carving revealed that the Sand People were the original people of Tatooine that Vossan had mentioned. Contacting Delk via a holocommunicator, the Consular revealed his findings to the man, and the latter advised that it was worth looking into a group of Sand People who had become overly aggressive and had recently attacked the nearby [[Farm/Legends|farming]] settlement of [[Malcolm's Dunes]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region.<ref name="Visions in the Sand">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Visions in the Sand|Tatooine}}</ref>

Once at Malcolm's Dunes, the Consular and his companion met Delk and the leader of the settlement, [[Hale Malcolm]]. The settlers were initially very aggressive toward the outsiders, since Vossan, the last Jedi they had helped by providing him with the coordinates of the [[Banthan Drifts camp|Sand People's camp]], had turned on them and had started sending the warrior people to attack them. However, the Consular convinced the farmers to provide help, and Malcolm drew a map of the route to the Sand People camp in the [[Banthan Drifts]] area.<ref name="Death in the Dunes">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Death in the Dunes|Tatooine}}</ref> The Jedi, his companion and Delk went to the camp to confront the ill Master, fighting through the Sand People, augmented and empowered by Vossan's influence. When the three finally found the Jedi Master himself, Vossan tried to convince the Consular that the Jedi Order should follow the Sand People's teachings&mdash;to abandon the weak and value strength only&mdash;before attacking them.<ref name="The Ultimate Warriors" />

[[File:Eriz_and_Tuskens.png|thumb|right|250px|Eriz Vossan and his Sand People warriors]]
The Consular and the companion fought the Jedi Master and emerged victorious. Vossan's interrogations revealed more details about the mission to Malachor Three, such as the fact that Parkanas Tark had saved Vossan there, but he had become trapped in the process and had been left behind by the other Jedi. The Consular shielded the Jedi Master, but his research on the Sand People still remained; Vossan effectively possessed knowledge on how to create an unstoppable army, and he consulted the Consular on what the Jedi should do with it. Believing that the knowledge was too dangerous and was against everything the Republic stood for, he advised Vossan to destroy the records.<ref name="The Ultimate Warriors" />

Around that time, Fess, still feeling shame over losing his Jagganath points, asked the Consular to pay tribute to his [[Qyzen Fess's father|father's]] remains, thinking that doing so would please the Scorekeeper. Fess's [[Parent/Legends|father]], a great hunter, had died years ago at the Dune Sea. Once the pair arrived at the resting place, the two were confronted by a young Trandoshan hunter, [[Lek Svaal]]. Svaal had been hunting a creature called the [[Dusk Shadow]] on Tatooine. He had laid a scent trail to the remains of Fess's father and had planted a trap rigged with explosives, an act dishonorable of a hunter in Fess's opinion. However, the Dusk Shadow attacked at that moment, making Svaal run away in horror. The Jedi and Fess killed the beast, and Fess completed his ritual at his father's grave. With the Trandoshan feeling much more at peace, the pair left Tatooine.<ref name="Shadow on the Sand">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shadow on the Sand|Tatooine}}</ref>

=====Helping the Teral=====
{{Main|Mission to Alderaan (Barsen'thor)}}
[[File:Organa_brothers.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi spoke with Hallam and Lew Organa upon arrival on Alderaan.]]
The Jedi and his crew [[Mission to Alderaan (Barsen'thor)|proceeded]] to fly to Alderaan,<ref name="Diplomacy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Diplomacy|Alderaan}}</ref> a former member world of the Republic now embroiled in a [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] after both [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]] and [[Prince/Legends|crown prince]] [[Gaul Panteer]] had died, and a noble named [[Bouris Ulgo]] had usurped the throne.<ref name="Alderaan codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The War for Alderaan's Throne}}</ref> Master [[Sidonie Garen]] had been working on Alderaan to organize a [[Alderaan Peace Summit|peace treaty]] between the noble houses of Alderaan, in an attempt to stop the war. However, she had raised the Jedi Council's suspicions by dropping out of contact for some time, so the Consular was assigned to contact her. The Jedi and a companion started the mission on Alderaan by talking to [[Hallam Organa]], the head of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] corps, who had been working closely with Garen.<ref name="Diplomacy" />

Organa contacted Garen, who was already at the peace summit's location, which was to be held at a [[Sendoth Ruins|secret meeting place]], but she declined to let the Consular come speak to her, stating that only representatives of Alderaan's noble Houses were allowed to come to the meeting. The Organa delegate was already at the summit, but Hallam and his brother [[Lew Organa|Lew]] advised the Jedi to seek a position of the representative for [[House Teral]], which was desperate to find a delegate after [[Unidentified Teral peace summit delegate|theirs]] had been murdered.<ref name="Diplomacy" /> The Consular and his companion traveled to the [[House Teral (estate)|Teral residence]], where they helped Captain [[Theress]] and the rest of House Teral's security force fend off a [[House Ulgo]] attack, which even included a number of Ulgo-controlled native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="Hostile Negotiations">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Hostile Negotiations|Alderaan}}</ref>

The two were granted audience with the leader of the House, Lord [[Teral (Lord)|Teral]]. The Jedi asked to be made the House's delegate, and Lord Teral agreed to grant the Jedi that title in exchange for his help in resolving the House's problems. In its current state, House Teral was extremely weak and unable to fend off Ulgo attacks. They planned to form an alliance with House Organa through a [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] between Lord Teral's daughter, [[Fasha Teral-Organa|Fasha Teral]], and Lew Organa, but the Teral needed to prove to the Organa that they had the ability to defend themselves against their enemies first. To this end, Lord Teral asked the Jedi and his companion to go to the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Ulgo's forces that besieged House Teral, [[Astar Vox]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who was known for being relatively honorable for his profession; the Teral hoped to sway Vox to their side and break the siege. When the pair attempted to negotiate with Vox at [[Astar Vox's camp|his camp]], the mercenary maintained that the Jedi had to prove himself in battle first.<ref name="Hostile Negotiations" />

The Jedi and his companion successfully fought off all the enemies Vox sent to fight them and convinced the mercenary to work for House Teral.
