Within, the three found three altars signifying the three tenets of the Voss society&mdash;life, death, and duty. Gaden-Ko stopped to meditate at each of the altars, causing ancient beasts within the ruins to awake and attack him. The Jedi Master defended Gaden-Ko as he meditated, slaying the beasts, including the [[Dark Heart Abomination]].<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" />

Gaden-Ko's meditation at the final altar summoned an apparition of his dead grandfather, [[Dajan-Ko]]. The spirit tempted his grandson with promises to resurrect his family, but Gaden-Ko declined, learning to accept the passing of those he loved and thus ending his journey as a trainee by receiving a vision of twin suns orbiting a planet. With that, Gaden-Ko became a full-fledged Mystic.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> The spirit of Dajan-Ko also recognized the Barsen'thor's efforts by directing him to an ancient artifact located inside the Deep Cradle.<ref name="Find the Ancient Artifact">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Find the Ancient Artifact|Voss}}</ref>

====Learning of the First Son====
{{Quote|You don't know who the First Son is. I'll share a little secret. Neither does he. You see, Jedi, some Children never know their true nature. They sleepwalk through life, until the Emperor wakes them.|Sophia Farash tells the Barsen'thor about the First Son|<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" />}}
Gaden-Ko and the Barsen'thor returned to Voss-Ka, where they spoke with the [[Three]]&mdash;[[Sonn-Vi]], [[Gunta-Mer]] and [[Nen-Ji]]&mdash;the leaders of the Voss society, inside the [[Tower of Prophecy]]. The Three informed the Jedi that Gaden-Ko's vision had been interpreted to mean that he had to leave with the Barsen'thor to learn from him. Alongside Gaden-Ko, an entire entourage of three vision interpreters, seven healers and sixty Voss commandos led by Jenar-Sei joined the Jedi Master's crew, traveling aboard other ships belonging to the Rift Alliance. Gaden-Ko also vouched for the Republic before the Three, asking them to consider to have the Voss enter an alliance with the galactic government. As the Barsen'thor, the Jedi's companion and Gaden-Ko were preparing to enter the Jedi's ship docked at the [[Voss Orbital Station]], they were met in the airlock by Ambassador Farash.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" />

[[File:Farash_revealed.png|thumb|right|250px|Sophia Farash trying to take Gaden-Ko away]]
The Ambassador, however, was trying to stop Gaden-Ko from leaving with the Jedi. She summoned two Sith apprentices to her side and pulled out a lightsaber, revealing herself to be one of the Emperor's Children and trying to take Gaden-Ko away to serve the Emperor. Force-pushing Gaden-Ko out of harm's way, the Barsen'thor and his companion fought Faresh, killing her apprentices but keeping her alive. The traitor then revealed to the Jedi the truth about the First Son&mdash;he was an unwilling [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]] unaware of his implanted identity, like several of the other Children had been programmed to be. The First Son's personality acted independently from its host, the latter having no memories of what his other persona did.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" />

Attracted by the commotion, Jenar-Sei and the Voss commandos entered the airlock, taking Farash into custody. According to Jenar-Sei, she was going to be executed by taking the "[[Step of Harmony]]" from a mountain in Voss-Ka. Even though the Jedi Master protested against such methods of dealing with the prisoner, she was taken away nonetheless. Gaden-Ko was then welcomed aboard the Jedi's ship, as the Barsen'thor departed Voss.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" />

====Capture of the ''Javelin''====
{{Main|Battle of Corellia}}
{{Quote|The Imperial fleet is protected by a dreadnaught, the ''Javelin''; without it, we could scatter them easily. However, a functional dreadnaught would be a huge asset in defending the Core Worlds. I need you and your alliance to capture the ''Javelin''.|Supreme Chancellor Janarus|<ref name="Shattering">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shattering|The ''Javelin''}}</ref>}}
The Barsen'thor was soon contacted by Bakarn and the Supreme Chancellor, who relayed the news on the course of the ongoing war. The Empire had assaulted the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Battle of Corellia|besieging]] the Republic world of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. A large Imperial fleet of thirty [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transports]] guarded by the prototype ''Harrower''-class dreadnought [[Javelin (Harrower-class)|''Javelin'']] was on its way to reinforce the Imperial armada at Corellia. Bakarn informed the Consular that he was on his way to assist Corellia's defenses. Meanwhile, seeing an opportunity, Chancellor Janarus ordered the Barsen'thor and his crew to board the ''Javelin'' and [[Capture of the Javelin|capture]] the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] intact. Boarding the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] en route to Corellia, the Barsen'thor took one companion and went to capture the bridge in order to force the Javelin's captain to surrender.<ref name="Shattering" />

[[File:Javelin_bomb.png|thumb|left|250px|The Barsen'thor found the ''Javelin'' rigged with explosives.]]
Meanwhile, other members of the Jedi's crew each took a number of Voss commandos and proceeded through different directions, securing other vital areas of the ship&mdash;the network room, the security, and the [[Armory/Legends|armory]]. At the same time, the [[Rift Alliance fleet|Rift Alliance's fleet]], reinforced by Hallow Voice's Esh-kha, engaged the troop transports. It soon became evident, however, that the dreadnaught was very lightly guarded. The reason behind it was revealed when the Barsen'thor reached the ship's bridge and found it deserted, aside from a droid designated [[LI-45]].<ref name="Shattering" />

The droid calmly stated that the ''Javelin'' was a trap rigged with enough [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] to destroy both the dreadnaught and the Rift Alliance fleet in the vicinity of it. There was not enough time to disarm all the charges, but by disarming enough of them, the Barsen'thor hoped to lessen the power of the ''Javelin''{{'s}} destruction so it would not harm his allies. Instructing the rest of the strike team to disarm as many charges as possible before evacuating, the Barsen'thor and the crew member accompanying him went for the closest explosives to their own position.<ref name="Shattering" />

As the ship started to break apart due to the explosions, the pair were contacted by one of the Barsen'thor's other crew members, who decided to stay aboard as long as possible in order to download what the companion thought was important Imperial data from the dreadnaught's computers. Although the Barsen'thor willed their comrade to leave immediately, the crew member planned to reach an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] at the last moment, and the Jedi and the rest of the crew had to concur and returned to the ''Defender''. As the ''Javelin'' met its demise, the Consular's men did indeed spot a single escape pod being launched toward Corellia, which was then guided by the planet's automated landing systems to crash-land somewhere at the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] area in the capital city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]].<ref name="Shattering" />

====The frontlines of Corellia====
{{Quote|We&hellip;just lost communication to the Guardian Holds. All our troops, their leaders&hellip;''"<br />"''If he takes the Guardian Holds, he can take Coronet City; that's the entire purpose of the Holds. Corellia is lost!|Masters Shan and Kaedan inform the Barsen'thor of the urgency of stopping the First Son|<ref name="Descent">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Descent|Corellia}}</ref>}}
Realizing that they would need help in tracking down the escape pod with the missing companion, the Barsen'thor's crew responded to a request for help made by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Captain [[Drizan]] in the [[Zone Twelve/Legends|Zone Twelve]] of the shipyards. The captain and his aide, the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Quil]], informed the Jedi that their forces could not risk sending rescue parties due to the threat of Imperial [[XR-32 hunter droid]]s that patrolled the area. The Jedi and a companion dispatched enough droids to make breaches in the Imperial security perimeter, allowing Quil's scouts to track the pod to an area in Zone Twelve that was heavily infested with Imperials.<ref name="Descent" />

[[File:Drizan.png|thumb|right|200px|Captain Drizan assisted the Barsen'thor in the search for his lost companion.]]
The pair fought their way through to the escape pod,<ref name="Descent" /> also assisting Drizan with the task of reclaiming two communication towers. Those towers had been converted into [[anti-aircraft gun]]s by the resistance but had been subsequently captured by the Empire; the Consular reprogrammed the guns to target Imperial positions.<ref name="AA Batteries">{{TORcite|type=bonus|AA Batteries|Corellia}}</ref> Cracking open the jammed escaped pod's door with the Force, the Jedi released the trapped companion.<ref name="Descent" />

The individual informed him of a successful retrieval of a lot of important Imperial data from the ''Javelin''. However, one file, which supposedly contained information on the First Son, was corrupted. The Jedi hoped to have Holiday fix the file at [[Captain Drizan's safehouse|Drizan's safehouse]], but the released crew member was too weak to walk. Calling on Quil's earlier promise to assist them in any way possible, the Jedi called several Selonian scouts to help, asking them to smuggle the injured companion to Drizan's base through secret [[Selonian Tunnels]].<ref name="Descent" />

Reuniting at the safehouse with the companion, the Jedi tried to restore the corrupted file, but Holiday was unable to do so by herself. In order to fix it, she required access to information from the Jedi Archives on Tython. The Barsen'thor sent a request to the Jedi Council, and Masters Shan and Kaedan granted Holiday full access to the Archives. She was able to repair the corrupted file, which contained a recording of a meeting between the First Son and [[Nadien]], a Secretary of the [[Corellian Council]]. To the Barsen'thor's shock, the First Son turned out to be none other than Syo Bakarn. Contacting Bakarn to let him explain himself, the Barsen'thor and the Jedi Council members were confronted by the personality of the First Son, who had taken full control over Bakarn's body and revealed that he had had his fellow Children placed inside [[Guardian Holds]], specialized fortified buildings spread across Coronet City that had the facilities and the resources needed to help the Republic in the retaking of the planet. As such, the Barsen'thor and the Jedi Master's companion were tasked with retaking the Holds, starting from the closest to their location, [[Guardian Hold Six]], a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] factory in Coronet's [[Labor Valley]].<ref name="Descent" />

====The Guardian Holds====
{{Quote|I know what you did to Blaesus, and Geland, and Sophia Farash. I'm not losing Guardian Hold Six to a monster like you.|Aelan Kalder|<ref name="A Fine Line">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|A Fine Line|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The two were contacted by Cordan, whose forces had landed on the planet and had tried to approach the facility, only to receive a distress call from a small force that had managed to escape from Guardian Hold Six and had set a [[Jari Orez's refuge camp|refuge camp]] near the facility. The leader of the survivors, the Mirialan Jedi [[Jari Orez]], was reluctant to accept help from Cordan's forces, not trusting the new arrivals after experiencing betrayal from his own soldiers.<ref name="Descent" /> Reaching Orez's camp, the Barsen'thor convinced the man that Cordan's forces were allies of the Republic. Orez revealed to the Consular that Guardian Hold Six had been taken under control by the soldier [[Aelan Kalder]], a Child of the Emperor, and he asked the Jedi to try to reason with Kalder, who was his close friend, if possible.<ref name="A Fine Line" />

Hoping to infiltrate the Guardian Hold and stop the Empire from producing walkers for themselves, the Barsen'thor decided to have Cordan's droids try to breach a weakened section of the facility's wall. The droids did their part, allowing the Jedi and a companion to slip inside the Hold and shut down the production of walkers, while Balmorran droids made their way further into the facility.<ref name="A Fine Line" />

[[File:Kalder_battle.png|thumb|left|275px|Aelan Kalder attacking the Barsen'thor with Force lightning]]
However, a number of already functional droids were activated by someone on the factory level, preventing Cordan's forces from making progress. The Jedi and his ally reached the factory floor, finding Kalder there, who wished to avenge the deaths of his fellow Children by the Barsen'thor's hand. Unable to bring Kalder back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] as Orez had hoped, the two defeated the traitor and the droids he tried to summon to his aid.<ref name="A Fine Line" />

The Barsen'thor retrieved the factory's activation codes from Kalder's body and reactivated the factory to aid the Republic. The First Son then contacted the Barsen'thor, who tried to bring back Bakarn by reminding the man of his friends and his duties as a Jedi. A glimpse of Bakarn emerged for a brief moment, but the First Son took back control and cut the communication. With Kalder defeated, Orez took back control of Guardian Hold Six, directing the Jedi's forces to [[Axial Park]], where another fortress, [[Guardian Hold Four]], had fallen to the enemy.<ref name="A Fine Line" />

Guardian Hold Four used to be called "Bakvalen Hall," a manor belonging to the prestigious [[Bakarn family|Bakvalen family]], and it had three major layers of security. A grid of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] was spread around Axial Park, warning the Hold's occupants of approaching hostiles. In addition to that, the Hold was protected by a force field and a security door. During a war council with Hallow Voice, Cordan, and Gaden-Ko in a [[Republic safe house (Axial Park)|Republic safe house]] in Axial Park, the Barsen'thor developed a plan of assault on the manor.<ref name="Old Blood" />

====Victory in sight====
{{Quote|The Emperor's words make everything clear, Jedi. The First Son will prevail, and you will die.|Saiak|<ref name="As Above, So Below">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|As Above, So Below|Corellia}}</ref>}}
Arriving at the manor, the Jedi first disabled enemy sensors in the vicinity, causing the Imperials occupying the Hold to lower the force field and send teams to investigate. The Imperial scouts were ambushed by the "Red Team," consisting of Gaden-Ko's Voss commandos. Meanwhile, Cordan's battle droids, the "Blue Team," moved inside the Hold's outer defensive perimeter and disabled the generators powering the main door. The Barsen'thor and a companion reached Guardian Hold Four, where they were confronted by members of the elite [[Imperial Guard]]. Defeating several members of the Guard along with their [[Unidentified Imperial Guard captain|captain]], the pair moved further into the Hold, discovering that Bakarn was actually a member of the Bakvalen family,<ref name="Old Blood" /> who had once occupied the manor and had at one point changed their last name to "Bakarn."<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Bakvalen Family}}</ref>

The Consular soon found another Child of the Emperor, the Republic [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Daresha]], accompanied by Imperial [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Grann (commander)|Grann]] and [[Merion]]. The Barsen'thor offered her a chance at redemption, but she did not accept it and attacked him. After killing Daresha, the Jedi Master took the generals prisoner, while his forces secured the Hold. Although General Merion refused to speak, Grann proved to be more reasonable. He revealed that with the fall of two Guardian Holds, the Imperial command, and possibly the First Son himself, would have most likely retreated into [[Guardian Hold One]], a secret bunker at the [[Governmental Sector|Government District's]] [[Capitol Square]].<ref name="Old Blood" />

As a Voss commando was sent by Gaden-Ko to investigate, the First Son established contact again, taunting the Barsen'thor for failing to redeem Daresha. The Consular tried to appeal once more to Bakarn's personality, reminding him of his lineage, but after a brief moment of clarity, the First Son reclaimed control. Soon, the Voss scout, [[Tasan-Ge]], reported that he had been unable to locate Guardian Hold One, but he relayed the location of Republic forces at the [[Drall Library]] in the Government District, who could assist the Jedi.<ref name="Old Blood" />

[[File:Saiak_revealed.png|thumb|right|250px|Saiak revealing himself as the Emperor's Child]]
Once there, the Jedi met Tasan-Ge's contact, the Republic Sergeant [[Rossiker]], who developed a plan to locate Guardian Hold One by tracking Imperial communications coming from within it. In order to do so, the Barsent'hor and a member of the Jedi Master's crew, supported by their army, took control of and reprogrammed heavily guarded communications terminals around Capitol Square. Rossiker was able to triangulate the Hold's location, and the Jedi Master breached it, finding two Corellian Councillors&mdash;[[Saiak]] and [[Delquis]]&mdash;as well as Secretary Nadien, hiding there from their own people, who despised them for selling the planet to the Empire.<ref name="As Above, So Below" />

The Barsen'thor demanded to know where the First Son was, but Saiak revealed himself to be a Child of the Emperor, killing Delquis. After killing Saiak, the Barsen'thor spoke to the surviving Secretary Nadien, who feared that he might turn out to be a Child himself. Assured that the death of the First Son would expose the other Children and would prove him not to be a sleeper agent, Nadien revealed that the First Son had used a secret hatch leading below Guardian Hold One into the tunnels beneath Coronet City. Leaving Gaden-Ko and Cordan to command the Rift Alliance forces defending Guardian Hold One from Imperial reinforcements, the Barsen'thor took one companion and followed the First Son, intending to stop him once and for all.<ref name="As Above, So Below" />

====The triumph of light====
{{Quote|Tell me why, Jedi. I stand unique among all other men in the galaxy. Why must I be destroyed?|First Son|<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />}}
Inside the cave below Guardian Hold One, the pair were confronted by two more Children of the Emperor that were accompanying their leader. After defeating them, the two confronted the First Son himself, with the Barsen'thor pleading to Master Bakarn's personality. The First Son, however, claimed that Bakarn was not powerful enough and he had gone silent forever. The First Son attacked the Jedi, blasting the Consular with Force lightning. Using the Force to heal the wound, the Barsen'thor engaged the First Son in battle. Midway through the fight, Bakarn attempted to reassert himself, using the Force to heal the First Son's opponents before the Sith personality regained control.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

[[File:Syo_defeats_the_First_Son.png|thumb|left|250px|Bakarn overwhelmed the First Son with the Force, imprisoning him within his mind.]]
As the First Son began to lose the fight, he tried to use the Force to collapse the cavern around them, intending to take the Jedi with him to the death. The Barsen'thor stopped him and finally defeated his adversary, weakening the First Son's grasp over Bakarn. The Barsen'thor once more willed the Jedi Master to break free, and Bakarn was finally able to do so, taking control of his body and containing the First Son within his mind. Thanking the Barsen'thor for not giving up on him and shocked at the atrocities he had committed as the First Son, Bakarn remained inside the cavern to recover, away from everyone. With the First Son locked away, the shield he had been creating around the other Children was gone, revealing them to the galaxy. After the Jedi Council was informed of Bakarn's redemption, they promised to have him returned to Tython to help him recover. While the fighting on Corellia still continued, the reclaiming of the Guardian Holds swayed the battle in the Republic's favor.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

The new Galactic Republic Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]],<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" /> [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3640 BBY|elected]] in an emergency session of the Senate after Janarus had been killed by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]],<ref name="Number One with a Bullet">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Number One with a Bullet|Corellia Orbital Station}}</ref> invited the Barsen'thor to Coruscant for an [[Coruscant award ceremony|award ceremony]]. With all of his allies present, the Barsen'thor was recognized for his courageous efforts in stopping the Children of the Emperor. For their assistance, member worlds of the Rift Alliance were rewarded with several billion credits, privileged access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] and extra support for their armies, with even more concessions promised in the future. A representative of the Rift Alliance for the Senate was also chosen by the Barsen'thor between Alauni, Duin, and Shuuru. The Esh-kha were accepted into the Republic, while as far as his reward was concerned, Gaden-Ko asked only to have more Jedi sent to Voss to learn the so-called "[[Gray Jedi|gray]]" aspects of the Force from the Mystics.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

After his tenure as the First Son, Bakarn could no longer keep a seat on the Jedi Council, so Masters Shan and Kaedan offered the seat to the Barsen'thor. Humbly accepting the promotion, the Jedi Master gave a final speech to those present at the ceremony before returning to active duty.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

===Ilum===
The Jedi Council helped Bakarn find a secret sanctuary where he continued to live in a self-imposed exile, carrying the burden of keeping the First Son within him for the rest of his days and spending all of his time to try to expose the other Children of the Emperor. Some time after his rescue, he sent the Barsen'thor one final message, once more thanking the Jedi for saving him and informing the latter that he had asked Grand Master Shan to keep him apprised of the Barsen'thor's career.<ref name="A Sanctuary">{{TORcite|type=message|A Sanctuary|Syo Bakarn}}</ref>

The Barsen'thor and his crew would continue to serve the Republic during the continuing war, joining the [[Battle of Ilum|fight]] against the Empire on the ice world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="Crystal Ball">{{TORcite|type=general|Crystal Ball|Ilum}}</ref> With the Emperor presumed by the galaxy to [[Dromund Kaas operation|have been killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi warrior]], the breakaway Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]] declared his [[New Empire|own empire]] during the Battle of Ilum, though the latter was defeated by the combined forces of the Republic and the Empire.<ref name="Battle of Ilum">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}}</ref><ref name="False Emperor">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref>

===The resurgence of Revan===
====Preserving the knowledge====
{{Quote|The Jedi Council must do more than react to crises. We must see to the future of the Order and the Republic. What we've seen in war, the truths we've learned, will be our gift to later generation. And few Jedi have seen or learned more than you.|Grand Master Satele Shan contacts the Barsen'thor on Rishi|<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Jedi Consular|Barsen'thor's Legacy|Rishi}}</ref>}}
The Barsen'thor's insight on the Jedi Council became invaluable for the war effort, and his remarkable Force affinity and countless previous achievements were respected by fellow Council members, including Grand Master Shan. As the war progressed, however, duty often called the Barsen'thor away from the Council chambers on Tython, and he continued to travel across the galaxy and assist wherever his help was needed.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" /> At one point in the year [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Revan date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> the Jedi Master and his crew found themselves on the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], a remote world infamous for being a haven for pirates. While in the city of [[Raider's Cove]], the Barsen'thor and a companion were contacted via holocomm by Shan, who informed the Jedi Master that the Jedi Council missed his presence on Tython.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

Members of the Council had also decided that in order to ensure a bright future for the Jedi, they needed to preserve all the knowledge they possessed, especially the discoveries made by the Barsen'thor, including the information about the shielding technique, the Esh-kha and the Children of the Emperor, among other things. As such, the Council wanted him to construct a [[Third Barsen'thor's holocron|personal holocron]], so future generations could consult it. According to Shan, a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Jedi Master and a master of holocron craft, [[Kutri O'a]]&mdash;who was known for his prophetic abilities&mdash;had wanted to meet the Barsen'thor for a long time and had arrived on Rishi days earlier, guided by the Force. Following Shan's instructions, the Barsen'thor met with O'a, who spoke of the visions he had received.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

[[File:Third_Barsenthors_holocron.png|thumb|right|250px|The Barsen'thor creating his holocron with Kutri O'a's help]]
According to him, the Barsen'thor's knowledge would be required by various individuals in many possible future scenarios. As the holocron was more than just a simple recording, being a reflection of the Barsen'thor's personality, O'a needed to scan his brain to establish a baseline for the holocron's matrix. However, in order to undertake the procedure, the Barsen'thor first needed to achieve a state of calm and serenity, referred to as the [[Susheer State]]. On Tython, achieving such a state could be possible by using a meditation chamber, but such technology was unavailable on the relatively primitive world of Rishi.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

However, like most cultures, the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] people also possessed rituals for attaining a higher state of consciousness, which could be used for the Jedi's purposes. The Bothan Jedi directed the Barsen'thor and a companion to the jungles of Rishi, in order to gather plants called [[kishu reed]]s for the ritual. During the process, the Jedi Master heard voices through the Force, visions of past and future. Guided by O'a via holocomm, he embraced those visions, meditated in the calming waters of a nearby waterfall and then burned the collected kishu reeds at a sacred Rishii location, meditating beside the fire. Doing those rituals helped the Barsen'thor achieve the Susheer State, and he returned to O'a, who had prepared an empty holocron for the procedure. In order for the device's crystal matrix to develop, it had to anchor itself to the Barsen'thor's knowledge and experiences. As such, O'a consulted the Force to receive glimpses of the future, asking the Barsen'thor what he would do in the situations presented. When the ritual was over, the Barsen'thor had successfully created a personal holocron, as requested by his fellow Jedi.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

====Battling the Order of Revan====
{{Quote|Your role in bringing light to the Revanites' conspiracy is only further proof of your tremendous skill and connection to the Force. What's more, you've battled against the Children of the Emperor and triumphed where so many others fell. The Order needs to remain vigilant against the Emperor's influences, and to uncover the true origins of his power so that we can fight him more effectively. The Council is proud to have such an ideal Jedi to lead those efforts.|Satele Shan speaks to the Barsen'thor in the aftermath of Revan's defeat|<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref>}}
[[File:Revan_Reborn.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Barsen'thor participated in the campaign against the resurgent Revan.]]
Shortly after the Barsen'thor departed from Rishi, a group of Republic troops and a group of Sith forces, led by Shan and Dark Council member [[Darth Marr]], respectively, forged a temporarily coalition in order to fight the common threat of the [[Order of Revan]]. The Order was currently led by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] himself,<ref name="Confederacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Confederacy|Yavin 4}}</ref> a Sith Lord-turned Jedi during the Jedi Civil War three hundred years ago, who had resurfaced during the Cold War.<ref name="KotOR date">{{TORcite|type=codex|Revan}}</ref> The Barsen'thor was among the heroes of the Republic who joined the fight against Revan on the moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where the mad Jedi planned to use a [[Temple of Sacrifice artifact|Sith artifact]] hidden inside the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] to bring back the Sith Emperor to a corporeal state and then properly kill him once and for all.<ref name="Confederacy" />

In the end, Revan was defeated, but all the destruction that had been produced by the fight between the Coalition and the Revanites had unwittingly served the Emperor's purposes, empowering his spirit and allowing him to escape to the outside galaxy. At the end of the fight, Shan tasked the Barsen'thor, as one of the most powerful and experienced Jedi Council members, to personally lead the search for the newly reborn Sith Emperor, in order to learn his secrets and find ways to stop Vitiate once and for all.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

===Disappearance and death===
{{Quote|Look around you. Zakuul is poised to become the greatest civilization in the history of the galaxy. I have forged this empire to surmount all of my previous works. To span eternity. The Eternal Throne commands a fleet more vast than any ever built. It has the power to reshape the galaxy into any image that I choose. That we choose. I will share all of this with you… if you will only kneel.|Vitiate, whose Eternal Empire conquered most of the galaxy in the Barsen'thor's absence|audio=ValkorionKneel.flac|<ref name="KotFE 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref>}}
According to Kutri O'a's visions, the Barsen'thor could have possibly attained many other titles during the years to come, such as the "Seneshal," the "Hierophant of the [[Jal Shey]]," and the "Betrayer of Balmorra."<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" /> In fact, the Barsen'thor had disappeared<ref name="KotFE 1" /> by the year [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="KOTFE date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> shortly after the conflict with Revan and around the time when Vitiate<ref name="KotFE 1" />&mdash;in the guise of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Valkorion]], yet another of his host bodies<ref name="KotET 2">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref>&mdash;led his clandestine [[Eternal Empire]] in a [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of both the Republic and the Sith Empire.<ref name="KotFE 1" /> [[3631 BBY|Five years later]], while the Eternal Empire had subjugated both galactic governments, the Jedi Master was still considered missing.<ref name="KotFE 3">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}}</ref>

By that point, most of the galaxy considered the Barsen'thor to be dead, but some individuals refused to believe in that theory, most notably the Jedi's Padawan, Nadia Grell. Believing that her Master had simply gone into hiding, she became obsessed with finding him. Grell scoured the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in search of the Barsen'thor&mdash;running into the Chiss Jedi Master [[Dazh Ranos]] at one point&mdash;but she was unsuccessful. The Padawan then continued her search in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], venturing deep into that unexplored region of the galaxy.<ref name="Nadia's fate">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=conversation|Dazh Ranos|Odessen}}</ref> Eventually, she returned to the known galaxy, fighting as a full-fledged Jedi on behalf of the Republic against the Eternal Empire, until she retreated to a [[Jedi Colony]] established by Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="Nadia's return">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Padawan and Her Master|Odessen}}</ref>

Lieutenant Iresso also tried to search for the missing Jedi Master. [[3635 BBY|A year after]] the Barsen'thor's disappearance, he heard rumors that the Jedi was being held captive on the planet [[Zakuul]], the capital of the Eternal Empire. Venturing there alone, Iresso was captured by the elite [[Knights of Zakuul]]. His captors found out about information from a Sith holocron implanted inside Iresso's brain,<ref name="Iresso's fate">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=class|Jedi Consular|Jail Broken|Odessen}}</ref>&mdash;a result of experiments Iresso had once endured in Imperial captivity<ref name="Doctor Fray's Secret">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Doctor Fray's Secret}}</ref>&mdash;and took him prisoner in an attempt to extract the holocron's secrets. The Republic learned of his capture but made no attempt to rescue him, merely listing the lieutenant as missing in action.<ref name="Iresso's fate" /> Eventually, an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] of various factions [[War against Zakuul|rose]] to successfully defeat the Eternal Empire and destroy Vitiate once and for all,<ref name="KotET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> fulfilling the task given to the Barsen'thor by Grand Master Shan years earlier.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

[[File:Forcesense_tomb.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Barsen'thor's tomb on Chandrila]]
At some point, the Barsen'thor did die, and he was laid to rest in a large [[Chandrila Jedi tomb|richly decorated tomb]] located in the famous region called the [[Crystal Canyons]] on the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> Located amidst a massive labyrinth of seemingly bottomless abysses connected by bridges and passages in the rock formations, the tomb was one of the several temple-like structures engraved into the canyon walls and decorated with numerous ornate pillars and statues of Jedi holding luminescent Force crystals.<ref name="Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

In the heart of the Barsen'thor's tomb was located the Jedi Master's casket, placed atop an altar decorated with a number of particularly large Force crystals. Two panels were located to the sides of the altar, with hidden markings above them that could only be [[Force sight|seen through the Force]] and which indicated some sort of importance in the panels. Indeed, by pressing those panels with the Force, a Force-user could activate a mechanism inside the altar that could seal or unseal the Barsen'thor's coffin from all sides by massive stone walls.<ref name="Jedi Academy" /> [[The Barsen'thor's lightsaber]] was one of a number of artifacts from the Jedi's travels that decorated the tomb.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Rest peacefully.|Jaden Korr, upon sealing the Barsen'thor's tomb on Chandrila|<ref name="Jedi Academy" />}}
O'a foresaw that after the Barsen'thor's death, Nadia Grell would take her Master's holocron and bury it in the forests of Sarkhai. In one future scenario, it would be found by a Sith who wanted to learn to be as powerful as the Barsen'thor. In another future, where the Republic would have fallen, the holocron would be found by a half-trained Sarkhai Jedi, who sought to use its secrets to achieve revenge on those responsible for the Republic's downfall.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" /> As millennia passed since the Barsen'thor's death, his name was lost to history, but tales of his diplomatic and battlefield victories remained.<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" />

The Republic did eventually fall,<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> as O'a had predicted in one of his visions,<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" /> and the Jedi Order had been all but [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], in his public persona as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], when any mention of the Jedi was outlawed, a respected historian, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Bleys Harand]], dared to publish a work titled ''[[Rediscovering the Jedi]]'', which focused on recollecting pieces of information about ancient Jedi and anything related to the nearly extinct Order. Harand's work&mdash;which was promptly banned in the Empire&mdash;contained a chapter on the Barsen'thor's tomb on Chandrila.<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> Eventually, Palpatine was slain, the Empire was defeated<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and a Jedi called [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] established the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> Throughout all those years, the presence of the Barsen'thor's remains<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" /> maintained his tomb as a powerful [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]], a site of great amounts of concentrated Force energy.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="JA date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'' are dated to [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the New Jedi Order [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis|faced the threat]] of a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Disciples of Ragnos]], who attempted to harness the Force energy from a number of such nexi using an ancient artifact, the [[Scepter of Ragnos]]. Venerating the dead Sith Lord [[Marka Ragnos]], the leader of the cult, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tavion Axmis]], planned to then use the energy contained in the Scepter to resurrect Ragnos himself. In preparation for her arrival with the Scepter, Axmis first dispatched a sizable number of her [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]] and elite [[New Reborn]] Dark Jedi to Chandrila, who breached and secured the Barsen'thor's tomb, exposing his coffin.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

[[File:Korr_on_chandrila.png|thumb|left|275px|Jaden Korr cleared the Barsenthor's resting place from the Sith cultists.]]
In response to that act of desecration, Skywalker [[Mission to Chandrila|dispatched]] a lone Jedi named [[Jaden Korr]], who had been only recently promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], to stop the cult's activities. Navigating through the maze-like passages of the Barsen'thor's resting place within the [[Crystal Canyons]], which had crumbled at certain places due to passage of time, Korr successfully defeated the enemy forces stationed there and used the two secret panels to close the Barsen'thor's sarcophagus, but in doing so, he started a reaction that caused a rockfall. Korr barely escaped from the place before it was sealed by the rocks&mdash;sealing off the tomb and ensuring that the Barsen'thor could continue to rest undisturbed&mdash;and he was later instrumental in [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|stopping]] the cult completely, having defeated Axmis and the spirit of Ragnos on the Sith world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==Personality and traits==
===A sharp mind and a pure soul===
[[File:Noetikon_of_Secrets_Hologram.png|thumb|right|250px|The Masters of the Noetikons were impressed with the Barsen'thor's desire for knowledge.]]
Even at a young age, the Barsen'thor displayed great wisdom and desire for knowledge.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> While teaching him the shielding technique, even the renowned Jedi Masters of the Noetikons were surprised to encounter such inquisitiveness.<ref name="Ancient Secrets" /> The Barsen'thor's sharp mind allowed him to answer the Master of Questions' riddles in order to escape Baddeg's trap on Coruscant,<ref name="Shadows" /> and recognize the appearance of the Voss commandos as a sign Gaden-Ko had been looking for on Voss.<ref name="Signs and Signifiers" /> A servant of the light side of the Force, the Jedi never diverged from its path, even if doing so would have made things easier for him. On Tatooine, the Jedi chose to destroy Master Vossan's research on augmenting the Sand People, which could have been invaluable in the war against the Empire.<ref name="The Ultimate Warriors" /> The Barsen'thor refused to accept Valon's offer of allegiance on Hoth, believing that Iresso's men deserved to see the criminal brought to justice.<ref name="Chasing the Legend" /> Striving to be honest with the population of Balmorra, the Jedi refused Zenith's offer to cover up President Galthe's broken state.<ref name="Passing the Torch" />

As a Jedi Master, the Barsen'thor tried to teach those virtues to his Padawan, stopping Nadia from killing Stark in anger, as doing so would have brought her close to the dark side.<ref name="Fearless" /> The Consular adhered to the Republic laws regarding the treatment of prisoners of war, agreeing with Doctor Jurnak's demands to provide an escort for him,<ref name="Cracks in the Armor" /> and preventing Zenith from killing the captive Imperial Trabier on Balmorra.<ref name="Our Points of View" /> The Jedi also displayed honesty by returning the valuable Force crystal recovered from the Gormak mining camp to the Voss, instead of keeping it for personal needs.<ref name="Signs and Signifiers" /> Feeling responsibility for the forces under his command, the Consular risked his own life to disarm as much of the detonite explosives aboard the ''Javelin'' as possible in order to save the Rift Alliance fleet from the explosion.<ref name="Shattering" />

As a member of the Jedi Council, the Barsen'thor was known for being a wise presence, yet the Jedi Master preferred to operate in the field to spending time on Tython. Fellow Council members respected the Barsen'thor's achievements, and they considered that preserving his knowledge was of great importance to the entire Jedi Order.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" /> Later, Grand Master Shan trusted the Barsen'thor with the crucial mission to find a way to stop the Sith Emperor.<ref name="The Enemy Within" /> Master O'a was also enthralled by the Barsen'thor's deeds and had wanted to meet him for a long time, until they finally met on Rishi.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

===Compassion and displays of mercy===
{{Quote|I'm still bleeding. Please, great Jedi, could you heal me? I'll never make it to the landing pad like this.''"<br />"''I cannot leave anybody in pain. Here, this will help.|The Barsen'thor heals the Imperial engineer on Hoth after defeating him in battle|<ref name="Into the White" />}}
The Barsen'thor was never indifferent to the suffering of others and strove to help those in need. On Coruscant, he healed the Black Sun smuggler suffering from the pain caused by the Noetikon inside of him.<ref name="The Flow of Goods" /> On Taris, when presented with the choice of saving the Junction's workers or the facility itself, the Barsen'thor chose the people.<ref name="The Junction" /> The Barsen'thor helped the Jawas on Tatooine to get their spare parts back<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy" /> and taught the cyborg Benx on Balmorra certain Jedi techniques that helped lessen the strain on his computerized brain.<ref name="Watchers" /> When offered with the chance to kill all hostile Esh-kha who were still in stasis, the Barsen'thor chose to continue keeping them in suspended animation.<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" />

[[File:The_Barsenthors_Allies.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Barsen'thor's allies]]
Realizing that the imprisonment of the Balmorran population was a trap set up by Darth Lachris, the Consular decided to rescue them nonetheless.<ref name="Executive Order 228" /> Not wiling to cause any harm to come to innocents because of his mission, the Barsen'thor refused to kill the Hutt spice factory workers on Nar Shaddaa, having Cedrax come up with the alternative plan of using the resonator key instead.<ref name="Running with the Lancers" /> When deciding the fate of the sabotaged ''Fortitude'', the Jedi Master chose to go with Nadia's plan, as the alternative could have had catastrophic consequences for the population of Deralia.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> When a wounded Imperial commando engineer on Hoth begged for mercy, the Barsen'thor healed him and let him go after extracting the required information.<ref name="Into the White" />

The Jedi applied that philosophy even to the psychotic prisoners on Belsavis, having Geland release them from their cells to avoid being killed by the exposure to toxins, only to have himself attacked by many of those released prisoners.<ref name="Taking on the Asylum" /> The Jedi did not let the Rakata monument which he had activated on Hoth remain active, destroying it to prevent it from brainwashing innocent strangers.<ref name="Counterpoint" /> On Voss, seeing the Nautolan Lefry Kaonai scared to stay alone, the Consular stayed with the man until the Republic extraction team arrived.<ref name="Nightmares" /> The Jedi displayed compassion even to his enemies, believing that the traitorous Farash did not deserve death penalty.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> When trying to help others, the Barsen'thor displayed great selflessness, using the shielding technique multiple times, aware of the dangers it presented to himself,<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> even trying to use it, albeit unsuccessfully, to restore President Galthe.<ref name="Passing the Torch" /> On Voss, the Jedi agreed to participate in the healing ritual to save Gaden-Ko, which caused him to experience the injured man's pain.<ref name="Marked" />

===Negotiating proficiency===
{{Dialogue|Sidonie Garen|House Thul is the reason the Panteer heir was assassinated. And House Ulgo is merely a puppet of House Rist.|House Ulgo delegate|Lies! All lies!|House Baliss delegate|There are holographic recordings, documents! You can't argue with hard evidence!|House Thul delegate|We trusted you&mdash;how dare you&mdash;you will meet our armies on the field of battle!|attr=The Barsen'thor attempting to defuse tensions at the Alderaan summit|src=<ref name="The Summit" />}}
When presented with a conflict situation, the Barsen'thor always sought to find a peaceful solution to the problem. During the search for the Fount of Rajivari, the Jedi convinced the Twi'leks under Raloch's command that their master had been corrupted and thus avoided confrontation with them.<ref name="Hunter's Eye" /> On Taris, when Padawan Vauranelle started to believe her Master's mad ramblings, the Jedi showed the young woman that Tykan was not sane.<ref name="Super Reactor" /> When confronted by the Hutt Cartel on Nar Shaddaa, the Jedi first assured them of having nothing to do with the attacks on the Hutt spice business and later negotiated a deal with the Cartel to let the Jedi Order have Duras Fain. While making his way to Fain's hideout, the Jedi avoided killing Imperial soldiers when possible, instead using distraction and negotiation to deal with them.<ref name="Shadow Town" /> Aboard the ''Carida'', the Consular talked down Fain's daughter from committing suicide and made her exit the airlock.<ref name="Distress Call" /> A diplomat and a negotiator, the Jedi swayed the mercenary Astar Vox to serve House Teral.<ref name="Hostile Negotiations" />

[[File:Rift_Alliance.png|thumb|left|250px|The Barsen'thor often used diplomatic skills to defuse heated discussions of the Rift Alliance members.]]
Later, he defused the tensions caused by the plague-affected Garen at the Alderaan peace summit and chose not to disturb the volatile situation by asking to strip House Ulgo of their status.<ref name="The Summit" /> Serving as an envoy to the Rift Alliance, the Barsen'thor made everything possible to meet the group's needs. Although they were initially distrustful of the Jedi,<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> by the time of the Children of the Emperor crisis, every member of the Rift Alliance was willing to follow the Barsen'thor in his mission to the very end. Some did so out of respect, while Cordan was also grateful for the liberation of his world and was willing to follow the Jedi no matter what.<ref name="To Serve the King" />

While negotiating a deal with Balmorra's corporations, the Barsen'thor refused to use Director Fenn's family as a bargaining chip, instead securing the deal with promises to lessen Jedi control over the production of weapons.<ref name="Watchers" /> The Jedi's negotiation skills worked even with non-organic opponents, such as the asylum custodian droid on Belsavis, who was successfully convinced by the Consular that Commander Geland was a traitor.<ref name="Taking on the Asylum" />

===Belief in redemption and leadership skills===
{{Quote|Kill me, and you will kill every Master I have ever infected. Every one! Shielded or not, they are still bound to me. But what choice do you have? You cannot let me live, and I am deathless. Your shielding talent cannot harm me. You've lost!''"<br />"''No matter what, Parkanas will be freed from you, Morrhage.|The Barsen'thor saves Parkanas Tark from the spirit of Morrhage|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />}}
[[File:Terrak_Morrhage.png|thumb|right|200px|The Jedi freed Parkanas Tark from the spirit of Terrak Morrhage.]]
The Jedi often took time to meditate in order to regain his strength and heal his injuries.<ref name="Mediation">{{TORcite|type=ability|Meditation}}</ref> The Barsen'thor strongly believed in the possibility of redemption for everyone. He refused to kill Raloch, instead having the man be accepted into the Jedi Order.<ref name="The Forge" /> Knowing that although killing Vivicar would stop the Dark Plague forever but would also kill the affected Masters, the Consular instead shielded him, saving Parkanas Tark and the Masters but risking the possibility of Morrhage's return at some point in the future.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> Later, the Jedi Master persuaded Darth Lachris's student, Serrus, to abandon the dark side, by reminding the man of his family.<ref name="Our Points of View" /> In the final moments of Lord Shendan, the Barsen'thor was successful in making the man feel the serenity of the holy place they were in.<ref name="Marked" />

When assaulting Guardian Hold Four, the Jedi also tried to save Corporal Daresha but was unsuccessful in doing so, a fact which the First Son used to try to convince the Barsen'thor of his failure as a Jedi. However, the Jedi soon proved the First Son wrong. After appealing multiple times to Bakarn's personality on Corellia,<ref name="Old Blood" /> the Barsen'thor was able to redeem the Jedi Master during their final confrontation.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" /> Despite usually striving to achieve his goals through peaceful methods, the Barsen'thor did not shy away from battle when pressed into it, and he often demonstrated great leadership skills on the battlefield. The Jedi Master was one of the masterminds behind the liberation of Balmorra, personally fighting alongside the Balmorran resistance on the war-torn world.<ref name="Passing the Torch" />

On Hoth, the Barsen'thor became the commander of the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces, leading the unit in the fight against Valon.<ref name="Chasing the Legend" /> Tasked by the Supreme Chancellor to find allies to fight against the Empire, the Barsen'thor assembled a sizable army consisting of thousands of Balmorran battle droids,<ref name="Passing the Torch" /> a fleet belonging to the members of the Rift Alliance,<ref name="Shattering" /> an entire army of Esh-kha<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" /> and sixty elite Voss commandos.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> He subsequently commanded that force during the Battle of Corellia, and his army played a crucial role in fighting off the Sith Empire's invasion.<ref name="As Above, So Below" />

Even some of his enemies respected the Barsen'thor's leadership abilities, with Blaesus believing that the Jedi could exploit any advantage given to him to achieve his goals. Due to that, Blaesus made sure to kill all the civilians and the Sarkhai soldiers alike aboard Waypoint Station Three to deny the Barsen'thor any potential resources to use against the Child of the Emperor.<ref name="To Serve the King" /> Although the Barsen'thor's birth name was eventually forgotten after his death, his achievements in diplomacy and on the fields of battle were remembered for thousands of years to come, well into the Imperial period, when Professor Belys Harand published his work, ''Rediscovering the Jedi''.<ref name="Force and Destiny Rulebook" />

===Relationships===
====Qyzen Fess====
{{Main|Qyzen Fess}}
{{Quote|I am past middle of life. Not so many years ahead. But plenty to see us win glory. Now come, Herald. Galaxy moves around us.|Qyzen Fess|<ref name="The Shko-Yagu">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|The Shko-Yagu}}</ref>}}
[[File:Qyzen_Fess.png|thumb|right|220px|Qyzen Fess]]
Unlike many members of his species, Fess did not become a mercenary, choosing the path of a hunter instead. Devoted to his goddess, the Scorekeeper, he traveled the galaxy for years, earning Jagganath points.<ref name="Fess codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Qyzen Fess (Consular)}}</ref> After witnessing the Consular's deeds on Tython, Fess came to regard the Jedi as the Scorekeeper's Herald and decided to join him in all future endeavors.<ref name="The Forge" /> He thought that his participation in the fight against Raloch was great honor for him. Although he was disgraced by losing all of his points due to his capture by Raloch, Fess believed that him meeting the Herald balanced out the loss.<ref name="Balance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|Balance}}</ref> During his travels, Fess had witnessed firsthand the [[Speciesism|prejudice]] other people felt toward Trandoshans, until Par had showed kindness toward him and had become his friend. By joining the Jedi's crew, the Trandoshan hoped that the Herald would become his friend as well.<ref name="Old Friends and New">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|Old Friends and New}}</ref>

The hunter would often share stories of his past hunts with the Herald, telling him about how he had lost his right eye, among other exploits.<ref name="The Scorekeeper's Lesson">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|The Scorekeeper's Lesson}}</ref> Although he was often displeased with the Consular's tendency to spare enemies,<ref name="Fess codex" /> Fess believed that the Jedi did so to let others hunt those enemies. The Trandoshan respected the Barsen'thor as a warrior, believing that the Herald had the heart of a Trandoshan hunter,<ref name="Hunter's Heart">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|Hunter's Heart}}</ref> and he considered the Herald's enemies, especially the Sith, to be worthy prey.<ref name="Memory's Claw">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|Memory's Claw}}</ref>

He viewed the Barsen'thor as a great example, pushing himself farther and training harder to match the Jedi.<ref name="Renewed">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|Renewed}}</ref> By the time he had joined the Herald, Fess was at his species' midlife point. According to Trandoshan customs, Fess subjected himself to the shko-yagu, a ritual that signified his rebirth and involved contemplation, fasting, and required him to continue hunting throughout it.<ref name="The Shko-Yagu" /> Few Trandoshans lived long enough to reach shko-yagu, and fewer survived it, due to its painful nature, as it required drinking medicine that induced fever and skin molt.<ref name="A Taste of Medicine">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Qyzen Fess|A Taste of Medicine}}</ref> The Barsen'thor helped Fess go through the shko-yagu,<ref name="Renewed" /> as well as helping him deal with the traitorous Trandoshan Veneb Drassk.<ref name="Straight and Narrow" /> As a sign of his gratitude, Fess swore his loyalty to the Herald for the rest of his days.<ref name="Hunter's Heart" /> After the Jedi's disappearance, Fess became the leader of the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], a group of Trandoshan mercenaries who had once tainted their reputation by going rogue and attempting to [[Battle of Denova|claim]] the strategic Republic world of [[Denova]] on behalf of their leader, Warlord [[Kephess]].<ref name="Fess Kotfe">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Stalking the Score|Hoth}}</ref>

====Tharan Cedrax and Holiday====
{{Main|Tharan Cedrax|Holiday (hologram)}}
{{Quote|I do believe I'm really feeling the benefits of some fresh air and exercise. Who would have thought? And the company of a true intellectual equal hasn't hurt either.|Tharan Cedrax|<ref name="Tharan's Masterpiece">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Tharan's Masterpiece}}</ref>}}
A charmer, mathematical [[Gambling/Legends|card-counting]] genius, and inventor of pioneering technological advances,<ref name="Cedrax codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Tharan Cedrax (Consular)}}</ref> Cedrax was bored with the lifestyle he led on Nar Shaddaa. That lifestyle was shaken up by the Consular's arrival on the moon.<ref name="The Professor" /> Thrilled with the prospect of seeking more adventure, Cedrax joined the Barsen'thor's crew, bringing his holographic companion Holiday with him.<ref name="Shadow Town" /> Although he was friends with two Jedi Masters, Duras Fain and Syo Bakarn,<ref name="The Professor" /> Cedrax nonetheless did not tolerate anything related to Jedi mysticism and usage of the Force to persuade others.<ref name="Cedrax codex" /> Despite the fact that the Barsen'thor displayed the traits he disliked, Cedrax considered the Jedi an intellectual equal,<ref name="Streamlined Performance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Streamlined Performance}}</ref> who possessed a rational mind.<ref name="Shattering" /> While aboard the Consular's ship, Cedrax received an invitation to the famous [[Lumenatus Club]], a prestigious organization for the most respected scientists.<ref name="Illumination">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Illumination}}</ref>

[[File:Tharan_and_Holiday.png|thumb|right|220px|Tharan Cedrax and Holiday]]
Seeing the invitation as a chance to prove himself the best scientist in the galaxy at the club's annual symposium, Cedrax wanted to create a technological marvel to show to his peers.<ref name="Illumination" /> Using his knowledge of exo-technology, Cedrax attempted to create the [[Vandrayk Generator]], a machine theorized hundreds of years ago by the inventor [[Gorman Vandrayk]].<ref name="Brainstorming">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Brainstorming}}</ref> Although he was successful at doing so, Cedrax's invention would only work for a minute if activated, after which its invaluable core would burn out.<ref name="Core of the Issue">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Core of the Issue}}</ref> However, the core could also be used to increase Holiday's [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] drastically. Although a minute of operation would be enough to win the symposium, Cedrax did not activate the Generator, instead choosing to use the generator's core for Holiday.<ref name="Tharan's Masterpiece" />

A unique creation, Holiday was a sentient hologram, alive in every aspect except for a physical body;<ref name="A Holiday from Hutta">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|A Holiday from Hutta}}</ref> she could project herself through a variety of holographic devices.<ref name="Holiday">In the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', if [[Tharan Cedrax]] is the player's active companion during the events of the [[Jedi Consular]] storyline, [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]] will often appear in cutscenes, [[Hologram/Legends|projecting]] herself on the player's [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] or through nearby technology.</ref> Emotional and cheerful, Holiday made herself feel at home aboard the Barsen'thor's ship at the very start, attempting to give "flair" to its computer systems.<ref name="Free From Care">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Free From Care}}</ref> Rescued by Cedrax from the clutches of [[Glorzo]] the Hutt in a deadly contest, Holiday felt deep attachment to, even love for, the scientist<ref name="A Holiday from Hutta" /> and was extremely protective of him.<ref name="Core of the Issue" /> When Cedrax became obsessed with the Vandrayk Generator, Holiday felt worried for him and pleaded the Barsen'thor to ask Cedrax to take a break. Although the Consular suspected that Holiday's love may have been programmed in by Cedrax himself, Holiday did not care even if that were the case, happy to have those feelings no matter where they came from. Overall, Holiday thought that the Barsen'thor was very kind to her.<ref name="Where Love Comes From">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Where Love Comes From}}</ref> She often assisted him in computer-related tasks,<ref name="Descent" /> as well as combat with enemies.<ref name="Deploy Holiday">{{TORcite|type=ability|Deploy Holiday}}</ref> Both Cedrax and Holiday considered the Jedi their good friend,<ref name="Poised on the Brink">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Poised on the Brink}}</ref> and were so addicted to adventuring life that they decided to stay aboard his ship indefinitely.<ref name="Projected Lifespan">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Tharan Cedrax|Projected Lifespan}}</ref>

====Zenith====
{{Main|Zenith}}
{{Quote|Want to let you know. Kind of enjoyed working with you. Not often my comrades survive this long. ''[&hellip;]'' Anyway, I just wanted to say. I&hellip;trust you. So I'd better stick around. Keep you alive. Trustworthy people are hard to come by.|Zenith, to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="Trust">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Trust}}</ref>}}
[[File:Zenith.png|thumb|right|220px|Zenith]]
When he joined the Consular's crew, Zenith was a hardened, battle-worn individual who harbored deep hatred for the Empire. So much so, that Cordan did not want him to be a part of his government, fearing that Zenith's hatred would be detrimental to the rebuilding of Balmorra.<ref name="Passing the Torch" /> Nonetheless, after joining the Barsen'thor, Zenith began a campaign to run for the post of the opposition leader in Balmorran government, to critique Cordan and provide his own point of view,<ref name="A Little Evidence">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|A Little Evidence}}</ref> a campaign that was successful with the Barsen'thor's advice.<ref name="Living in the Future">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Living in the Future}}</ref> Once a member of the resistance cell led by his deceased mentor [[Gray Star]], Zenith followed Gray Star's teachings, not letting his guard down and thinking that every friend was a potential enemy.<ref name="Friends and Favors">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Friends and Favors}}</ref> Not used to having political power, Zenith was also at a loss of what to do in peaceful times.<ref name="Unfamiliar Peace">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Unfamiliar Peace}}</ref>

During his political campaign, Zenith displayed much of the ruthlessness that Cordan so feared, willing to lie,<ref name="A Little Evidence" /> orchestrate accidents to happen to his opponents,<ref name="Speaking Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Speaking Out}}</ref> and severely punish collaborators who had worked with Imperial occupation forces.<ref name="The Fate of Collaborators">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|The Fate of Collaborators}}</ref> Although it was initially hard to open up to anyone for him,<ref name="Friends and Favors" /> eventually Zenith came to trust the Barsen'thor.<ref name="Trust" /> Believing the Jedi to be "all right,"<ref name="Flawless">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Zenith|Flawless}}</ref> Zenith was willing to stay at his side to protect him from harm.<ref name="Trust" />

====Felix Iresso====
{{Main|Felix Iresso}}
{{Quote|I want you to know I'm with you to the end. Win or lose. I'd rather be your lieutenant than a Republic colonel. Doesn't matter what comes next for us. I've got your back.|Lieutenant Iresso|<ref name="Some Thinking">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Some Thinking}}</ref>}}
[[File:FelixHS.png|thumb|right|220px|Felix Iresso]]
A Republic soldier who had been kicked from posting to posting around the galaxy until he ended up assigned to the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces on Hoth, Iresso was happy to leave the frozen planet. Although he was going to miss his unit, he felt happy knowing that his men were going home.<ref name="Going Home">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Going Home}}</ref> Although he had met few Jedi in his life, Iresso believed that the Barsen'thor was more proactive than those he did meet.<ref name="Scorekeeping">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Scorekeeping}}</ref> He thought that there was more to life than work, and advised the Consular that even Jedi should sometimes take a break.<ref name="There's More To Life">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|There's More To Life}}</ref> Iresso was eager to fight the Empire<ref name="To Seek Victory">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|To Seek Victory}}</ref> and admired the Jedi's fighting style, especially his ability to both follow tactics and improvise when needed. He subsequently tried to adjust his own style to match.<ref name="Natural Talent">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Natural Talent}}</ref>

Striving to be honest with the Jedi, Iresso told the Barsen'thor that the reason he had been transferred so many times was because he had been once captured by the Empire. During a scouting [[Mission to Althir III|mission]] to [[Althir III|Althir]] with his friend [[Milo Pellam]], Iresso and Pellam had been captured by Imperial forces. Iresso had eventually escaped, but he had lost seven days of his life from his memory.<ref name="The Lost Days">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|The Lost Days}}</ref> When Pellam&mdash;who had not been seen since that day&mdash;resurfaced, Iresso spoke with the man, finding him in a broken state of mind, talking about a glowing box the Imperials had used on both of them.<ref name="The Man He Was">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|The Man He Was}}</ref> Eventually, Iresso located one of his torturers, the defected Imperial doctor [[Sera Fray]], who revealed that the glowing box was in fact the contents of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] planted inside both Iresso's and Pellam's minds on the orders of the Sith [[Darth Ouzal]]. The procedure had broken Pellam completely, but Iresso had managed to only lose a portion of his memory.<ref name="Doctor Fray's Secret" />

The Barsen'thor helped the soldier handle the fact that he was carrying a library of Sith knowledge in his brain, and Iresso was thankful for the fact that the Jedi was always near when he needed the moral support.<ref name="Reaching Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Reaching Out}}</ref> Believing that he could always count on the Barsen'thor, Iresso wanted to stay aboard the ship.<ref name="Making Plans">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Felix Iresso|Making Plans}}</ref> Considering the Consular's case worth fighting for,<ref name="Reaching Out" /> the lieutenant came to regard his service aboard the Barsen'thor's ship as the best posting he ever had, and he promised to always cover the Jedi's back when needed.<ref name="Some Thinking" /> After the Barsen'thor's disappearance, Iresso's loyalty led him on a foolhardy mission to investigate rumors of the Jedi's presence on Zakuul, which resulted in the lieutenant's capture and imprisonment by the Eternal Empire.<ref name="Iresso's fate" /> According to Kutri O'a's visions, in one future scenario, Iresso would die to defeat a Sith individual. Centuries later, one of the Sith's descendants would find the Barsen'thor's holocron.<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy" />

====Nadia Grell====
{{Main|Nadia Grell}}
{{Quote|I've been thinking about home. The training's helped me be honest with myself. I'm not going back. I'll be their representative, but too much has happened for me to just settle there again. And I'm happy about that. You've given me a new life. All I want is to see the next horizon, and keep learning. With you.|Nadia Grell, speaking to her Master|<ref name="Words of Comfort">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Words of Comfort}}</ref>}}
[[File:Nadia_Grell.png|thumb|right|220px|Nadia Grell]]
The Barsen'thor first met Nadia aboard the ''Fortitude'', and she and her father stayed aboard the Jedi's ship alongside other members of the Rift Alliance after that.<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> A powerful Force-sensitive, Nadia was able to amplify her powers with her raw emotions.<ref name="Attis Station" /> When her father was killed, the Barsen'thor accepted Nadia as his Padawan in honor of the man's final will.<ref name="Fearless" /> It was very hard for the young woman to deal with the loss of her father, as she had dreams of him calling her.<ref name="Coming to Terms">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Coming to Terms}}</ref> She then asked her Master how he managed to stay so composed<ref name="Being Composed">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Being Composed}}</ref> and deal with the constant displays of violence around them.<ref name="Dreaming of Peace">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Dreaming of Peace}}</ref>

Nadia was very loyal and protective of her friends, including the Barsen'thor.<ref name="Nadia general">{{TORcite|Nadia Grell's in-combat comment: ''"No one hurts my friends!"''}}</ref> With the death of her father, she was appointed by the royal family as the new representative of Sarkhai to the Republic.<ref name="New Responsibilities">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|New Responsibilities}}</ref> The Consular subsequently helped her acquaint herself with the new responsibilities and settle various disputes on her homeworld.<ref name="The Fate of the Annex">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|The Fate of the Annex}}</ref><ref name="Words of Comfort" /> Eager to learn, Nadia often asked her Master on her progress as a Padawan. She herself felt that the training helped her better control her powers and made her feel more herself.<ref name="A Step Forward">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|A Step Forward}}</ref> As part of her learning process, Nadia asked her Master what being a Padawan meant,<ref name="First Lessons">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|First Lessons}}</ref> and she wanted to visit Tython to see the Jedi homeworld with her own eyes.<ref name="Begin at the Beginning">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Begin at the Beginning}}</ref>

Although she missed her home, the girl wanted to stay at the Barsen'thor's side to explore the galaxy<ref name="New Responsibilities" /> and learn as much as possible about being a Jedi.<ref name="Home">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|Home}}</ref> As her training progressed, Nadia started to feel a [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bond]] with her Master, feeling his presence and seeing through the Barsen'thor's eyes across great distances.<ref name="The Bond of Jedi">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Nadia Grell|The Bond of Jedi}}</ref> When the Barsen'thor disappeared, Nadia refused to believe that he had died. Her loyalty to her Master drove the young Padawan to relentlessly search for the Barsen'thor throughout the Unknown Regions and Wild Space. When Master Ranos met Grell, she noticed that the girl was completely obsessed with the idea of finding her Master.<ref name="Nadia's fate" /> The obsession eventually faded, as Nadia later abandoned her search for her Master, dedicating all her efforts on the war against the Eternal Empire, even resigning her commission as the Senator of Sarkhai. With the war going badly for the Republic, the Barsen'thor's former apprentice sought refuge inside Master Gnost-Dural's Jedi Colony on Ossus.<ref name="Nadia's return" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|A Padawan who was stronger in the Force at four years old than I was at fifteen?|Master Yuon Par regards her Padawan's strength and innate power|<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />}}
Considered a child prodigy, the Barsen'thor had first Force powers manifest very early in his life.<ref name="Attis Station" /> He had a remarkable connection with the Force, stronger than many Jedi of the current era, including his own Master, Yuon Par.<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> Trained as a Jedi Consular, the Barsen'thor was a master of wielding the Force, both to bolster his own strength as well as to weaken enemies. The Jedi was able to move with [[Force speed/Legends|Force-enhanced speed]] and use a variety of powers that tempered with the minds of his enemies. The Jedi was at least somewhat proficient with Force healing,<ref name="Abilities">In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a third of the abilities that a [[Jedi Consular]] can learn are accessible to either advanced class&mdash;the [[Jedi Sage]] and the [[Jedi Shadow]]. Sages can learn an additional third and Shadows can learn the remaining third. This article only mentions the abilities accessible to both advanced classes.</ref> using it to heal an Imperial engineer on Hoth,<ref name="Into the White" /> Hallow Voice on Belsavis,<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" /> Gaden-Ko on Voss,<ref name="A Thorny Path" /> and to heal himself during the battle with the First Son.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

[[File:LariaSaved.png|thumb|left|275px|The Barsen'thor uses the Force to levitate Laria to safety.]]
The Barsen'thor was especially versed in telekinesis, utilizing Force push in battles with Aelan Kalder<ref name="A Fine Line" /> and the First Son,<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" /> as well as using it to push Gaden-Ko away from Sophia Farash.<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> While helping the lost expedition on Taris, the Consular lifted a large piece of debris to save people trapped beneath it and then used the Force to levitate two more expedition members, rescuing them from the fire.<ref name="The Expedition" /> While trying to save the workers of the Junction, the Jedi used the Force to break open a blast door.<ref name="The Junction" /> Later, when trying to seal the rakghoul tunnels in the Republic base on Taris, the Barsen'thor used the Force to collapse rock formations, both directly and by picking up and throwing a load lifter into the rocks.<ref name="Rakghoul Invasion" />

When Commander Geland blocked passage to Hallow Voice's chamber with a heavy blast door, the Consular was able to channel so much Force that the door was ripped to shreds.<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" /> While rescuing his trapped companion from the escape pod on Corellia, the Jedi used the Force to remove the pod's jammed hatch.<ref name="Descent" /> The Consular's Jedi training also allowed him to survive the exposure to any airborne toxins by holding his breath for prolonged periods of time.<ref name="Taking on the Asylum" /> He could sense the emotions of others in the Force, although he failed to sense that Blaesus was a traitor, only picking up traces of fear during the man's time aboard his ship.<ref name="To Serve the King" />

Most notable, the Barsen'thor was the only Jedi of his time to have learned the shielding technique from the Noetikons, applying it to remove Sith corruption or harmful effects of a target.<ref name="Shadows" /> This shielding technique was used primarily to deal with the Dark Plague created by Terrak Morrhage, and the Barsen'thor could indeed remove the harmful effects of the plague from its victims, although it drained his own life force with each use. However, unlike the last known practitioner of the technique, the Barsen'thor was able to defeat Morrhage without driving himself to death.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> The technique was limited to Force-induced corruption and could not help those whose mind had been shattered through physical torture.<ref name="Passing the Torch" /> The Barsen'thor had at least a minor proficiency in wielding a lightsaber. During the training on Tython, he wielded a training saber. Eventually, the Padawan used the hilt of the First Blade to construct a lightsaber, which initially had a green-colored lightsaber crystal.<ref name="The Forge" />

[[File:First_Blade.png|thumb|right|300px|The Barsen'thor's lightsaber]]
Shortly after being promoted from Padawan, the Jedi chose an advanced specialization, either that of Jedi Sage or Jedi Shadow.<ref name="Advanced Training: Jedi Consular" /> Despite not necessarily looking like a formidable opponent to many of his enemies,<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> the Barsen'thor's skills with the lightsaber and his mastery of the Force were enough to defeat multiple dangerous opponents, including Nalen Raloch,<ref name="The Forge" /> Lord Vivicar,<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> Captain Valon,<ref name="Chasing the Legend" /> many Children of the Emperor&mdash;Augin Blaesus,<ref name="To Serve the King" /> Geland,<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" /> Sophia Farash,<ref name="Deep Cradle, Dark Heart" /> Aelan Kalder,<ref name="A Fine Line" /> Daresha,<ref name="Old Blood" /> Saiak<ref name="As Above, So Below" />&mdash;and even the First Son himself.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" />

In addition to speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the Barsen'thor was versed in many [[Language/Legends|languages]] of the galaxy. He could understand [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]],<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> [[Gand (language)/Legends|Gand]],<ref name="The Arrival" /> [[Binary/Legends|Binary]],<ref name="The Expedition" /> [[Nikto (language)|Nikto]]<ref name="The Professor" /> [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]],<ref name="Looking Out for the Little Guy" /> [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]],<ref name="Rebirth" /> [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]], [[Selkath (language)|Selkath]],<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites" /> [[Rakata (language)|Rakata]]<ref name="Taking on the Asylum" /> [[Esh-kha language|Esh-kha]],<ref name="The Voice From The Tomb" /> and [[Mandaba/Legends|Mandaba]].<ref name="Descent" /> In addition, the Barsen'thor was a skilled pilot, successfully performing many flight missions for the Coruscant Aegis under the callsign "Guardian."<ref name="Help the Republic Fleet" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Trained in the arts of the Force, driven by curiosity and the search for knowledge, the Jedi Consular sees that through the Force, all things are connected.|Joanna Berry, the writer of the Consular storyline|<ref name="Joanna Berry">{{TORweb|url=news/blog/20100305_001|text=Finding Balance in the Force|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
